Character appearance bc_ff4_n001.en: Broad blue and violet plate covers the limbs and broad shoulders. A yellow stripe and pointed gold ornaments cross the dark visor, and a dark blue cape fans outward in the raised battle pose.
Character appearance bc_ff4_n001.ja: 青と紫の幅広い板金鎧が手足と広い肩を覆う。暗い面を黄色い筋と尖った金の飾りが横切る。戦闘で体を起こすと濃青のマントが扇形に広がる。

Character appearance bc_ff4_p001.en: A compact fighter wears dark indigo plate with layered spiked shoulders, pale wrist openings and a long pointed helmet. Gold marks show at the eye and below the boots. The side battle pose shows a hooked helmet crest and a bare hand held close to the chest.
Character appearance bc_ff4_p001.ja: 小柄な戦士が藍色の暗い板金鎧を着ける。肩に棘のある板が重なり、手首の開口部が淡く、兜は長く尖る。目元と長靴の下に金の模様。戦闘で横を向くと鉤形の兜飾りと胸の近くに抱えた素手が見える。

Character appearance bc_ff4_p002.en: A bright cyan dragon helm has a long pointed snout, swept gold side markings and a tiny red eye. Blue pointed shoulder plates, violet boots and a short tailing sash cover the rest. The battle pose shows a narrow exposed cheek beneath the visor and a long pointed waist panel.
Character appearance bc_ff4_p002.ja: 鮮やかな水色の竜の兜に長く尖った鼻、横へ流れる金の模様と小さな赤い目がある。尖った青い肩甲、紫の長靴と短く流れる帯が残りを覆う。戦闘姿では面の下から細い頬と腰の長い尖り板が見える。

Character appearance bc_ff4_p002_c01.en: The long dragon helm, spiked shoulders and narrow waist use rich violet and pink-violet shades, with gold and red accents. The ready battle stance crouches behind large layered plates.
Character appearance bc_ff4_p002_c01.ja: 長い竜の兜、尖った肩、細い腰は濃紫と桃紫で、金と赤の差し色がある。戦闘で構えると、重なった大きな装甲板の後ろにうずくまる。

Character appearance bc_ff4_p003.en: A fair-haired woman with a pale face and green eyes wears green upper clothing and a long white cloak or skirt with pink trim. A high ponytail and longer white cape trail in the battle pose.
Character appearance bc_ff4_p003.ja: 淡い顔と緑の目の金髪の女性。緑の上着に、桃色で縁取った長い白の外套かスカートを着ける。戦闘では高いポニーテールと長めの白いマントが後ろに流れる。

Character appearance bc_ff4_p004.en: A short pale figure has sweeping green hair, a pink hair accent and bright blue and pink clothing. A yellow cape trails behind the field and battle forms, with a gold shoulder detail clearly outlined in battle.
Character appearance bc_ff4_p004.ja: 背の低い色白の人物。流した緑の髪に桃色の髪飾り、鮮やかな青と桃色の服。黄色いマントが野外でも戦闘でも後ろへ流れ、戦闘では肩の金飾りがはっきりする。

Character appearance bc_ff4_p005.en: A broad bearded man has a large blue and orange helmet with a pale horizontal goggle band. The field outfit includes brown beard and shoes, red-orange sleeves and blue fabric. The battle sprite has heavy orange gloves, wide dark trousers and big boots.
Character appearance bc_ff4_p005.ja: 肩幅の広いひげの男。大きな青と橙の兜に、淡い横長のゴーグルが付く。野外では茶色のひげと靴、赤橙の袖、青い布が見える。戦闘では重そうな橙の手袋、幅広い暗いズボンと大きな長靴を着ける。

Character appearance bc_ff4_p006.en: A small elder has flyaway white hair, a long white beard and blue circular spectacles. He wears a bright purple and pink cloak edged with gold. The large cape swings outward in the battle Ready frame.
Character appearance bc_ff4_p006.ja: 小柄な老人物。逆立つ白髪と長い白ひげ、青い丸眼鏡がある。金で縁取った鮮やかな紫と桃の外套を着け、戦闘で構えると大きなマントが外へ翻る。

Character appearance bc_ff4_p007.en: A slim fair-haired man wears a red cap with white trim, green scarf and long green cape, red tunic and short brown boots. His light sleeves and longer blond hair are clearer in the side battle frame.
Character appearance bc_ff4_p007.ja: 金髪で細身の男。白い縁の赤い帽子、緑のスカーフと長い緑マント、赤い上着、短い茶の長靴を着ける。戦闘で横を向くと淡い袖と長い金髪がよく見える。

Character appearance bc_ff4_p008.en: A muscular bare-chested fighter has a shaved front scalp, short dark facial hair, a braided tail of hair, blue wraps and red trousers with yellow trim. Battle Ready shows large bare fists and the victory pose stretches one red leg and braid horizontally.
Character appearance bc_ff4_p008.ja: 筋肉質で上半身裸の格闘家。頭の前側を剃り、短い黒いひげと、編んだ長い髪がある。青い巻き布と黄色で縁取った赤いズボン。戦闘で構えると大きな素手の拳が見え、勝利時は赤い片脚と編み髪が水平に伸びる。

Character appearance bc_ff4_p009.en: A young pale figure with a brown bob wears a short white and green outfit and a bright red cape. Small boots and a short trailing gold tie appear beside the cape in battle.
Character appearance bc_ff4_p009.ja: 色白で茶色のボブの若い人物。短い白と緑の服に鮮赤のマントを羽織る。戦闘ではマントの横に小さな長靴と短く流れる金の紐が見える。

Character appearance bc_ff4_p010.en: A young pale figure has swept brown hair, a small top tie and a bright green cape over a white-and-orange outfit. The battle Ready frame spreads the green cloth and emphasizes the cream front.
Character appearance bc_ff4_p010.ja: 若い色白の人物で、流した茶髪を頭頂で小さく結ぶ。白と橙の服の上に鮮緑のマント。戦闘で構えると緑の布が広がり、クリーム色の前身頃が目立つ。

Character appearance bc_ff4_p011.en: A lean pale figure has spiky white hair, a lavender lower-face guard and a white-violet scarf, arm guards and coat. The side battle frame shows the layered blue and gold trim, dark knees and long scarf ends.
Character appearance bc_ff4_p011.ja: 淡い顔の細身の人物。尖った白髪、淡紫の下顔当て、白紫のスカーフと腕当て、上着を身に着ける。戦闘の横姿では青と金の重なった縁、暗い膝と長いスカーフの端が見える。

Character appearance bc_ff4_p012.en: A bald elder has a huge light blue-white beard and trailing white hair. A purple robe and cape drape to the floor. Battle sprites show the beard sweeping almost to the ground beside one pale edge of his robe.
Character appearance bc_ff4_p012.ja: 禿頭の老人物で、青白い大きなひげと後ろへ流れる白髪がある。紫のローブとマントが床まで垂れる。戦闘では淡色のローブの縁の横で、ひげが地面近くまで曲がる。

Character appearance bc_ff4_p013.en: A fair figure wears ivory and gold armor, a lavender swept hairstyle or headpiece and a red brow jewel. The battle figure has more gold armor at the knees and shoulders and a cream cape that opens to show red lining.
Character appearance bc_ff4_p013.ja: 色白の人物。象牙色と金の鎧、流した淡紫の髪か頭飾りと赤い額の宝石。戦闘では膝と肩に金の板が増え、クリーム色のマントが開いて赤い裏地を見せる。

Character appearance bc_ff4_p014.en: A slim pale figure wears a fitted bright green outfit with trailing sleeves or fabric. Long vivid green hair has a little pink ornament. Battle frames show the gold green collar, side-swept hair and a bare raised arm.
Character appearance bc_ff4_p014.ja: 色白で細身。体に沿う鮮緑の衣装の袖か布が垂れ、長い鮮緑の髪に小さな桃色の飾りがある。戦闘では金緑色の襟と横に流れる髪、持ち上げた素肌の腕が見える。

Character appearance fa_ff4_p001.en: A navy full helm has curved silver side horns, a closed face guard and gold shoulder bands.
Character appearance fa_ff4_p001.ja: 紺色の全頭兜に曲がった銀の横角、閉じた顔当てと金の肩帯が付く。

Character appearance fa_ff4_p002.en: The angular blue dragon-shaped helm has red accents above two slate eyes and a narrow exposed mouth.
Character appearance fa_ff4_p002.ja: 角張った青い竜の兜。赤い飾りの下に青灰色の目が二つと細く開いた口が見える。

Character appearance fa_ff4_p003.en: Long golden hair frames a pale face, with green eyes, pink lips and a red forehead jewel.
Character appearance fa_ff4_p003.ja: 長い金髪が淡い顔を囲む。緑の目、桃色の唇と赤い額の宝石がある。

Character appearance fa_ff4_p004.en: Bright green hair frames a round pale face, one blue-green eye and a pink hair ornament.
Character appearance fa_ff4_p004.ja: 鮮緑の髪が丸く淡い顔と青緑の片目を囲み、桃色の髪飾りが付く。

Character appearance fa_ff4_p005.en: A big brown beard and broad nose show below a blue and orange cap with square gray goggles.
Character appearance fa_ff4_p005.ja: 角張った灰色のゴーグル付きの青と橙の帽子の下に、太い茶ひげと幅広い鼻が見える。

Character appearance fa_ff4_p006.en: A wrinkled pale face has bushy white hair and beard, blue lenses and a pink and gold collar.
Character appearance fa_ff4_p006.ja: しわのある淡い顔に、ふさふさした白髪と白ひげ、青い眼鏡と桃色と金の襟がある。

Character appearance fa_ff4_p007.en: A long-haired blond profile wears a brimmed red feathered cap and a green collar.
Character appearance fa_ff4_p007.ja: 長い金髪の横顔。羽根とつばの付いた赤帽子と緑の襟を着ける。

Character appearance fa_ff4_p008.en: A bald brow, straight dark mustache and long bound braid flank his light-brown face and red-orange neck ornament.
Character appearance fa_ff4_p008.ja: 明るい褐色の顔に剃った額、まっすぐな黒い口ひげ、長く結んだ編み髪と赤橙色の首飾りがある。

Character appearance fa_ff4_p009.en: Round pale cheeks, dark eyes and a small mouth sit beneath a short brown bowl fringe.
Character appearance fa_ff4_p009.ja: 茶色のおかっぱ前髪の下に丸く淡い頬、暗い目と小さな口がある。

Character appearance fa_ff4_p010.en: A rounded young face has swept brown bangs, dark eyes and a small colored hair ornament.
Character appearance fa_ff4_p010.ja: 丸い若い顔で、茶色の前髪を流し、暗い目と小さな色付き髪飾りがある。

Character appearance fa_ff4_p011.en: Angular eyes peer over a violet mask beneath white spiked hair. A small colored earring sits near the mask edge.
Character appearance fa_ff4_p011.ja: 尖った白髪の下で、紫の覆面の上から角張った目がのぞく。覆面の縁近くに小さな色付きの耳飾りがある。

Character appearance fa_ff4_p012.en: A long silver-blue beard and hair stream behind a high bare brow and a single visible eye.
Character appearance fa_ff4_p012.ja: 高いむき出しの額と片方だけ見える目の後ろに、銀青色の長いひげと髪がなびく。

Character appearance fa_ff4_p013.en: A light profile has long swept silver-blue hair, blue eyes and a gold headband with a red jewel.
Character appearance fa_ff4_p013.ja: 淡い横顔に長く流れる銀青色の髪、青い目、赤い宝石がある金の鉢巻き。

Character appearance fa_ff4_p014.en: A longer green hairstyle frames a pale face and narrow eyes, with a pink flower above the brow.
Character appearance fa_ff4_p014.ja: 長めの緑の髪が淡い顔と細い目を囲む。眉の上に桃色の花がある。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_001_c00.en: A small, hunched figure has a long pointed cap, a hooked nose, a large pointed ear and a raised clawlike hand. The other hand wields a short curved blade. It wears green and gold.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_001_c00.ja: 小柄な人物が背を丸める。長い尖り帽子に鉤鼻、大きな尖り耳があり、爪のような片手を上げる。もう片手に短く曲がった刃を持つ。服は緑と金。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_001_c01.en: A small, hunched figure has a long pointed cap, a hooked nose, a large pointed ear and a raised clawlike hand. The other hand wields a short curved blade. It wears red and rose.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_001_c01.ja: 小柄な人物が背を丸める。長い尖り帽子に鉤鼻、大きな尖り耳があり、爪のような片手を上げる。もう片手に短く曲がった刃を持つ。服は赤とばら色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_001_c02.en: A small, hunched figure has a long pointed cap, a hooked nose, a large pointed ear and a raised clawlike hand. The other hand wields a short curved blade. It wears violet and orange.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_001_c02.ja: 小柄な人物が背を丸める。長い尖り帽子に鉤鼻、大きな尖り耳があり、爪のような片手を上げる。もう片手に短く曲がった刃を持つ。服は紫と橙色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_002_c00.en: A stocky four-legged lizard crouches with clawed feet, long curling tail, ridged back and two long horns over a toothy snout. Thin whiskerlike strands hang from the jaw. It is orange and gold.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_002_c00.ja: ずんぐりした四足のトカゲが、爪のある足でうずくまる。長い尾を巻き、背に隆起があり、歯をむく鼻面の上に長い角二本がある。あごから細いひげのような筋が垂れる。橙と金色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_002_c01.en: A stocky four-legged lizard crouches with clawed feet, long curling tail, ridged back and two long horns over a toothy snout. Thin whiskerlike strands hang from the jaw. It is slate and olive-gray.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_002_c01.ja: ずんぐりした四足のトカゲが、爪のある足でうずくまる。長い尾を巻き、背に隆起があり、歯をむく鼻面の上に長い角二本がある。あごから細いひげのような筋が垂れる。青灰とオリーブがかった灰色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_002_c02.en: A stocky four-legged lizard crouches with clawed feet, long curling tail, ridged back and two long horns over a toothy snout. Thin whiskerlike strands hang from the jaw. It is indigo and bright blue.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_002_c02.ja: ずんぐりした四足のトカゲが、爪のある足でうずくまる。長い尾を巻き、背に隆起があり、歯をむく鼻面の上に長い角二本がある。あごから細いひげのような筋が垂れる。藍色と鮮青色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_003_c00.en: A large bird lowers its hooked beak and trails bent legs with open talons. One great layered wing rises above its back and sweeps outward. It is brown and cream.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_003_c00.ja: 大鳥が鉤形のくちばしを下げ、脚を曲げて鉤爪を開く。背の上から羽の重なる大きな翼が上がり、外へ広がる。茶色とクリーム色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_003_c01.en: A large bird lowers its hooked beak and trails bent legs with open talons. One great layered wing rises above its back and sweeps outward. It is blue, cream and yellow.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_003_c01.ja: 大鳥が鉤形のくちばしを下げ、脚を曲げて鉤爪を開く。背の上から羽の重なる大きな翼が上がり、外へ広がる。青、クリーム、黄色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_003_c02.en: A large bird lowers its hooked beak and trails bent legs with open talons. One great layered wing rises above its back and sweeps outward. It is green and dark pink with yellow feet.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_003_c02.ja: 大鳥が鉤形のくちばしを下げ、脚を曲げて鉤爪を開く。背の上から羽の重なる大きな翼が上がり、外へ広がる。緑と濃桃色で足は黄色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_004_c00.en: A single round eye protrudes from an oval body above a slanting grin full of small teeth. Long pointed wings curve down around it, with little claws at the tips. It has a teal body, gray wings and a pale eye.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_004_c00.ja: 楕円の胴から丸い一つ目が突き出す。斜めの笑い口に小さな歯が並ぶ。長く尖った翼が周りを下へ曲がり、先に小さな爪がある。青緑の体と灰色の翼、淡色の目。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_004_c01.en: A single round eye protrudes from an oval body above a slanting grin full of small teeth. Long pointed wings curve down around it, with little claws at the tips. It has a red body, green wings and a mint eye.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_004_c01.ja: 楕円の胴から丸い一つ目が突き出す。斜めの笑い口に小さな歯が並ぶ。長く尖った翼が周りを下へ曲がり、先に小さな爪がある。赤い体と緑の翼、ミント色の目。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_004_c02.en: A single round eye protrudes from an oval body above a slanting grin full of small teeth. Long pointed wings curve down around it, with little claws at the tips. It has a gold body and lavender wings and eye.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_004_c02.ja: 楕円の胴から丸い一つ目が突き出す。斜めの笑い口に小さな歯が並ぶ。長く尖った翼が周りを下へ曲がり、先に小さな爪がある。金色の体と淡紫の翼と目。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_004_c03.en: A single round eye protrudes from an oval body above a slanting grin full of small teeth. Long pointed wings curve down around it, with little claws at the tips. It is green with violet wings and eye.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_004_c03.ja: 楕円の胴から丸い一つ目が突き出す。斜めの笑い口に小さな歯が並ぶ。長く尖った翼が周りを下へ曲がり、先に小さな爪がある。緑の体と紫の翼と目。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_005_c00.en: A curled insectlike body has overlapping back plates, a row of short feet, upright antennae and a broad rounded belly. It has blue-gray plating with orange bands.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_005_c00.ja: 昆虫のような丸まった体。背に板が重なり、短い足が並ぶ。触角が立ち、腹が幅広く丸い。青灰色の装甲に橙の帯。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_005_c01.en: A curled insectlike body has overlapping back plates, a row of short feet, upright antennae and a broad rounded belly. It has green plating with violet bands.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_005_c01.ja: 昆虫のような丸まった体。背に板が重なり、短い足が並ぶ。触角が立ち、腹が幅広く丸い。緑の装甲に紫の帯。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_005_c02.en: A curled insectlike body has overlapping back plates, a row of short feet, upright antennae and a broad rounded belly. It has cyan plating with gold bands.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_005_c02.ja: 昆虫のような丸まった体。背に板が重なり、短い足が並ぶ。触角が立ち、腹が幅広く丸い。水色の装甲に金の帯。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_006_c00.en: A small bat spreads two scalloped membrane wings. Pointed ears, bright eyes and small dangling feet surround its short body. It has sand-colored wings and gray-brown fur.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_006_c00.ja: 小さなコウモリが、縁が波形の翼膜を二枚広げる。短い胴の周囲に尖り耳、光る目、小さく垂れる足がある。砂色の翼に灰褐色の毛。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_006_c01.en: A small bat spreads two scalloped membrane wings. Pointed ears, bright eyes and small dangling feet surround its short body. It has rose and orange wings and violet-gray fur.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_006_c01.ja: 小さなコウモリが、縁が波形の翼膜を二枚広げる。短い胴の周囲に尖り耳、光る目、小さく垂れる足がある。ばら色と橙の翼に灰紫色の毛。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_006_c02.en: A small bat spreads two scalloped membrane wings. Pointed ears, bright eyes and small dangling feet surround its short body. It has red and violet wings and indigo fur.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_006_c02.ja: 小さなコウモリが、縁が波形の翼膜を二枚広げる。短い胴の周囲に尖り耳、光る目、小さく垂れる足がある。赤と紫の翼に藍色の毛。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_007_c00.en: An upright tree trunk stands on splayed roots. Bare angular branches reach from the sides. A jagged pale split runs down the front like an open mouth. It has charcoal-green bark and a gold-white center.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_007_c00.ja: 根を広げた直立する木の幹。葉のない角張った枝が両脇から伸びる。前に淡いぎざぎざの割れ目が口のように開く。黒に近い緑の樹皮に金白色の中央。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_007_c01.en: An upright tree trunk stands on splayed roots. Bare angular branches reach from the sides. A jagged pale split runs down the front like an open mouth. It has burgundy bark and an icy blue center.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_007_c01.ja: 根を広げた直立する木の幹。葉のない角張った枝が両脇から伸びる。前に淡いぎざぎざの割れ目が口のように開く。暗い赤紫の樹皮に氷青色の中央。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_008_c00.en: A low ratlike quadruped has a pointed snout, short feet and a bare tail curled over its back. Long sharp quills stand above the body in dense rows. It is violet and gray.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_008_c00.ja: ネズミに似た低い四足獣。鼻先が尖り、足は短く、毛のない尾を背に巻き上げる。長く鋭い針が体の上で密に並ぶ。紫と灰色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_008_c01.en: A low ratlike quadruped has a pointed snout, short feet and a bare tail curled over its back. Long sharp quills stand above the body in dense rows. It is orange and brown.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_008_c01.ja: ネズミに似た低い四足獣。鼻先が尖り、足は短く、毛のない尾を背に巻き上げる。長く鋭い針が体の上で密に並ぶ。橙と茶色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_008_c02.en: A low ratlike quadruped has a pointed snout, short feet and a bare tail curled over its back. Long sharp quills stand above the body in dense rows. It is blue and pale cyan.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_008_c02.ja: ネズミに似た低い四足獣。鼻先が尖り、足は短く、毛のない尾を背に巻き上げる。長く鋭い針が体の上で密に並ぶ。青と淡い水色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_009_c00.en: A small, round-faced figure has orange-brown hair or a hood, a green outfit and orange shoes. One arm sticks out beside its face.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_009_c00.ja: 丸顔の小柄な人物。橙褐色の髪か頭巾、緑の服と橙色の靴がある。片腕が顔の横から突き出る。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_010_c00.en: A hunched biped has a pointed fishlike snout, a spiny silhouette and long bent arms with narrow claws. Its tapered legs end in pointed toes. It is pink, orange and cream.

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_012_c01.en: An upright segmented insect bends forward, with many thin legs along the inside of its curved body. Rounded front plates cover long dangling fangs. It has indigo plating, orange markings and red-gold legs.

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_048_c00.en: A hunchbacked humanoid is built from heavy angular blocks. It has a small scowling face, long blocky arms, thick hands and broad feet. It is ochre.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_048_c00.ja: 背を丸めた人型が重い角張った塊でできている。小さな険しい顔と角張った長い腕、厚い手、幅広い足がある。黄土色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_048_c01.en: A hunchbacked humanoid is built from heavy angular blocks. It has a small scowling face, long blocky arms, thick hands and broad feet. It is light cyan and lavender.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_048_c01.ja: 背を丸めた人型が重い角張った塊でできている。小さな険しい顔と角張った長い腕、厚い手、幅広い足がある。淡い水色と淡紫。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_048_c02.en: A hunchbacked humanoid is built from heavy angular blocks. It has a small scowling face, long blocky arms, thick hands and broad feet. It is dark magenta-gray.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_048_c02.ja: 背を丸めた人型が重い角張った塊でできている。小さな険しい顔と角張った長い腕、厚い手、幅広い足がある。暗い赤紫がかった灰色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_049_c00.en: A squat little frog has large raised eyes, a pale chest and short splayed legs. The frog is pink and purple.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_049_c00.ja: ずんぐりした小さなカエル。大きく突き出た目に淡い胸、短く広げた脚がある。桃色と紫。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_049_c01.en: A squat little frog has large raised eyes, a pale chest and short splayed legs. The frog is green with a yellow chest and orange cheek.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_049_c01.ja: ずんぐりした小さなカエル。大きく突き出た目に淡い胸、短く広げた脚がある。緑の体に黄色い胸と橙色の頬。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_050_c00.en: A humanoid upper body with long flowing hair and slender arms rises from a broad spider body with long, pointed jointed legs. It has pink skin and violet legs.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_050_c00.ja: なびく長髪と細い腕の人型の上半身が、関節のある尖った長い脚を持つ幅広いクモの体から伸びる。桃色の肌と紫の脚。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_050_c01.en: A humanoid upper body with long flowing hair and slender arms rises from a broad spider body with long, pointed jointed legs. It has pale blue-green skin and dark olive legs.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_050_c01.ja: なびく長髪と細い腕の人型の上半身が、関節のある尖った長い脚を持つ幅広いクモの体から伸びる。淡い青緑の肌と濃いオリーブ色の脚。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_051_c00.en: A low mechanical turret has a ridged teal pedestal and a barrel built from blue and copper rings. An orange sphere glows in its barrel, with a pointed turquoise beam spreading ahead.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_051_c00.ja: 背の低い機械の砲塔。青緑の土台に筋があり、青と銅色の輪が砲身を作る。砲口で橙の球が光り、尖った青緑の光線が前に広がる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_052_c00.en: A long low dragon has an angular armored torso, a curling tail, jointed claws and swept-back wings tipped with long spines. It is silvery cyan.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_052_c00.ja: 地面に近い長い竜。角張った鎧の胴、巻いた尾、節のある爪があり、後ろに流れる翼に細長い棘が付く。銀色がかった水色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_052_c01.en: A long low dragon has an angular armored torso, a curling tail, jointed claws and swept-back wings tipped with long spines. It is indigo and blue-white.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_052_c01.ja: 地面に近い長い竜。角張った鎧の胴、巻いた尾、節のある爪があり、後ろに流れる翼に細長い棘が付く。藍色と青白色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_052_c02.en: A long low dragon has an angular armored torso, a curling tail, jointed claws and swept-back wings tipped with long spines. It is orange and red with blue accents.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_052_c02.ja: 地面に近い長い竜。角張った鎧の胴、巻いた尾、節のある爪があり、後ろに流れる翼に細長い棘が付く。橙と赤の体に青の差し色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_053_c00.en: A slender imp balances on one bent leg. It has a grinning horned head, outstretched claws, small bat wings and a long tail. It is green with ochre membranes.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_053_c00.ja: 細身の小鬼が曲げた片脚でバランスを取る。にやりと笑う角のある頭に、伸ばした鉤爪、小さなコウモリの翼と長い尾が付く。緑の体に黄土色の翼膜。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_053_c01.en: A slender imp balances on one bent leg. It has a grinning horned head, outstretched claws, small bat wings and a long tail. It is red-orange with dark blue wings.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_053_c01.ja: 細身の小鬼が曲げた片脚でバランスを取る。にやりと笑う角のある頭に、伸ばした鉤爪、小さなコウモリの翼と長い尾が付く。赤橙の体に濃青の翼。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_054_c00.en: A stooped figure floats or crouches in a broad billowing dress with one bent knee visible. A wide mantle shadows the face, and segmented bands hang from the curled tip of a thin staff. It has pale hair and green clothing.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_054_c00.ja: 前かがみの人物が、ふくらむ幅広いドレスを着て浮くか身をかがめる。曲げた片膝が見える。幅広い肩衣が顔に影を落とし、巻いた細い杖先から節のある帯が垂れる。淡い髪に緑の服。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_054_c01.en: A stooped figure floats or crouches in a broad billowing dress with one bent knee visible. A wide mantle shadows the face, and segmented bands hang from the curled tip of a thin staff. It has lavender hair and purple clothing.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_054_c01.ja: 前かがみの人物が、ふくらむ幅広いドレスを着て浮くか身をかがめる。曲げた片膝が見える。幅広い肩衣が顔に影を落とし、巻いた細い杖先から節のある帯が垂れる。淡紫の髪に紫の服。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_054_c02.en: A stooped figure floats or crouches in a broad billowing dress with one bent knee visible. A wide mantle shadows the face, and segmented bands hang from the curled tip of a thin staff. It has orange-brown hair and a navy and brown robe.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_054_c02.ja: 前かがみの人物が、ふくらむ幅広いドレスを着て浮くか身をかがめる。曲げた片膝が見える。幅広い肩衣が顔に影を落とし、巻いた細い杖先から節のある帯が垂れる。橙褐色の髪に紺と茶のローブ。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_055_c00.en: A bare muscular torso leans forward, dissolving into coils at the waist. Loose flames or wisps curl around the arms and base. It is white-hot orange and gold.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_055_c00.ja: むき出しの筋肉質な胴が前に傾き、腰から巻いた筋に変わる。腕と根元の周りを炎か光の筋が巻く。白熱した橙と金色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_055_c01.en: A bare muscular torso leans forward, dissolving into coils at the waist. Loose flames or wisps curl around the arms and base. It is bright violet and pink.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_055_c01.ja: むき出しの筋肉質な胴が前に傾き、腰から巻いた筋に変わる。腕と根元の周りを炎か光の筋が巻く。鮮やかな紫と桃色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_056_c00.en: A bulky dragon sits upright on thick clawed limbs, its long horned head lowered near the ground. A pair of high angular wings spreads over its back. It has green scales and gold membranes.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_056_c00.ja: 大柄な竜が爪のある太い手足で体を立てて座る。角のある長い頭を地面近くに下げ、角張った高い翼二枚を背に広げる。緑の鱗に金の翼膜。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_056_c01.en: A bulky dragon sits upright on thick clawed limbs, its long horned head lowered near the ground. A pair of high angular wings spreads over its back. It has orange-gold scales and violet-blue membranes.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_056_c01.ja: 大柄な竜が爪のある太い手足で体を立てて座る。角のある長い頭を地面近くに下げ、角張った高い翼二枚を背に広げる。橙金色の鱗に青紫の翼膜。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_057_c00.en: A hovering mechanical eye has rounded overlapping shells. One large round lens peers from the lower opening, and narrow prongs project below. It uses yellow shells and an indigo casing.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_057_c00.ja: 丸い外殻が重なる空飛ぶ機械の目。下の開口部を、大きな丸いレンズ一つがのぞき、下に細い突起が伸びる。黄色い装甲と藍色の外枠。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_057_c01.en: A hovering mechanical eye has rounded overlapping shells. One large round lens peers from the lower opening, and narrow prongs project below. It uses gold shells and a pink casing.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_057_c01.ja: 丸い外殻が重なる空飛ぶ機械の目。下の開口部を、大きな丸いレンズ一つがのぞき、下に細い突起が伸びる。金色の装甲と桃色の外枠。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_057_c02.en: A hovering mechanical eye has rounded overlapping shells. One large round lens peers from the lower opening, and narrow prongs project below. It uses gray-white shells and a dusky red casing.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_057_c02.ja: 丸い外殻が重なる空飛ぶ機械の目。下の開口部を、大きな丸いレンズ一つがのぞき、下に細い突起が伸びる。灰白色の装甲とくすんだ赤の外枠。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_058_c00.en: A narrow hovering machine has a blue visor, gold and gray shoulder domes, a wedge-shaped torso and long sharp panels hanging like legs and arms.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_058_c00.ja: 細身の浮く機械。青い面当て、金と灰色の丸い肩、くさび形の胴がある。腕や脚のような細長い尖った板が垂れる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_059_c00.en: A many-tentacled mass is built around one wide, red horizontal mouth lined with sharp teeth. Little pink buds cap the upright tendrils and thick green appendages trail along the floor.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_059_c00.ja: 触手がいくつも生えた塊。鋭い歯の並ぶ赤い横長の口が大きく開く。立ち上がる触手に桃色の小さなつぼみが付き、太い緑の突起が床を這う。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_060_c00.en: A long serpentine dragon coils almost into a circle, with a narrow horned face, spines along the neck and a tail curling down from the coil. It is steel-blue and white.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_060_c00.ja: 細長いヘビのような竜がほぼ一周するほどとぐろを巻く。角を持つ細い顔、首に並ぶ棘、とぐろから下へ巻く尾がある。鋼青色と白。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_060_c01.en: A long serpentine dragon coils almost into a circle, with a narrow horned face, spines along the neck and a tail curling down from the coil. It is yellow and olive.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_060_c01.ja: 細長いヘビのような竜がほぼ一周するほどとぐろを巻く。角を持つ細い顔、首に並ぶ棘、とぐろから下へ巻く尾がある。黄色とオリーブ色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_060_c02.en: A long serpentine dragon coils almost into a circle, with a narrow horned face, spines along the neck and a tail curling down from the coil. It is bright blue with green flecks.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_060_c02.ja: 細長いヘビのような竜がほぼ一周するほどとぐろを巻く。角を持つ細い顔、首に並ぶ棘、とぐろから下へ巻く尾がある。鮮青色に緑の小斑点。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_060_c03.en: A long serpentine dragon coils almost into a circle, with a narrow horned face, spines along the neck and a tail curling down from the coil. It is violet and purple.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_060_c03.ja: 細長いヘビのような竜がほぼ一周するほどとぐろを巻く。角を持つ細い顔、首に並ぶ棘、とぐろから下へ巻く尾がある。青紫と紫。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_061_c00.en: A round dark-centered organism trails many curling feelers and a dense fan of long fine filaments. It glows green and cyan.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_061_c00.ja: 真ん中が暗い丸い生き物。巻いた触角がいくつも流れ、長く細い筋が密集して扇形に広がる。緑と水色に光る。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_061_c01.en: A round dark-centered organism trails many curling feelers and a dense fan of long fine filaments. It glows orange, pink and violet.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_061_c01.ja: 真ん中が暗い丸い生き物。巻いた触角がいくつも流れ、長く細い筋が密集して扇形に広がる。橙、桃色、紫に光る。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_062_c00.en: A huge purple stone face has a long nose, deeply carved eyes, a broad brow and bared teeth. Sharp edges and ridged fragments frame the face.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_062_c00.ja: 巨大な紫の石の顔。長い鼻、深く彫った目、幅広い額、むき出しの歯がある。鋭い縁と筋のある破片が顔を囲む。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_063_c00.en: A bulky armored machine has a curved horn atop its head, a large circular attachment on one shoulder, heavy boots and claws at the ends of its hands. It has red plating with green and gold trim.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_063_c00.ja: ごつい装甲の機械。頭の上に曲がった角と、片肩に大きな丸い付属品がある。重そうな長靴と手の先の爪が見える。赤い装甲に緑と金の縁。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_063_c01.en: A bulky armored machine has a curved horn atop its head, a large circular attachment on one shoulder, heavy boots and claws at the ends of its hands. It has silver-blue armor and a gold and red shoulder attachment.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_063_c01.ja: ごつい装甲の機械。頭の上に曲がった角と、片肩に大きな丸い付属品がある。重そうな長靴と手の先の爪が見える。銀青色の装甲に金と赤の肩の付属品。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_064_c00.en: An upright horned dragon has heavy clawed limbs, a long underplated tail and wide bat wings. Its folded wings and body use indigo, white and olive.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_064_c00.ja: 角のある竜が直立する。爪のある重い手足、腹側が板で覆われた長い尾と幅広いコウモリ状の翼がある。折りたたんだ翼と胴は藍色、白、オリーブ色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_064_c01.en: An upright horned dragon has heavy clawed limbs, a long underplated tail and wide bat wings. Its wings draw in close. The dark brown and red body has an orange belly.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_064_c01.ja: 角のある竜が直立する。爪のある重い手足、腹側が板で覆われた長い尾と幅広いコウモリ状の翼がある。翼を体に引き寄せる。濃茶と赤の体に橙の腹。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_065_c00.en: An upright horned dragon has heavy clawed limbs, a long underplated tail and wide bat wings. Its blue and olive body stretches horizontally between spread pale-violet wings.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_065_c00.ja: 角のある竜。爪のある重い手足、腹側が板で覆われた長い尾と幅広いコウモリ状の翼がある。青とオリーブ色の体が広げた淡紫の翼の間で水平に伸びる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_065_c01.en: An upright horned dragon has heavy clawed limbs, a long underplated tail and wide bat wings. Its brown and red body stretches horizontally between spread salmon wings.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_065_c01.ja: 角のある竜。爪のある重い手足、腹側が板で覆われた長い尾と幅広いコウモリ状の翼がある。茶と赤の体が広げたサーモン色の翼の間で水平に伸びる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_066_c00.en: A massive low-slung beast is deep violet, with long red dorsal spines, yellow claws, a long thin tail and huge curved yellow fangs. Thin yellow strands extend from its head.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_066_c00.ja: 巨大な濃紫の獣が地面近くに身を低くする。長い赤い背棘、黄色い爪、長く細い尾と巨大な曲がった黄色い牙がある。頭から黄色い細い筋が伸びる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_067_c00.en: It is a translucent white-lavender dragon with an upright spiked head and a spread wing, rising from rippling mist.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_067_c00.ja: 白と淡紫の半透明な竜が、波打つ霧の上に立ち上がる。棘のある頭を垂直に上げ、翼を広げる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_068_c00.en: It leaves a flat band of separate pale lavender mist streaks spreading across the ground.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_068_c00.ja: 淡紫の霧の筋がところどころ離れた平らな帯となって、地面に広がる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_069_c00.en: A tapering orange-and-blue head with rows of tiny teeth is surrounded by separate orange-and-blue curling tentacles. Eight separated tentacles curve around its head.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_069_c00.ja: 橙と青の先細りの頭に小さな歯が並ぶ。頭の周りに橙と青の巻いた触手が八本、それぞれ離れている。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_070_c00.en: A tapering orange-and-blue head with rows of tiny teeth is surrounded by separate orange-and-blue curling tentacles. Seven separated tentacles curve around its head.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_070_c00.ja: 橙と青の先細りの頭に小さな歯が並ぶ。頭の周りに橙と青の巻いた触手が七本、それぞれ離れている。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_071_c00.en: A tapering orange-and-blue head with rows of tiny teeth is surrounded by separate orange-and-blue curling tentacles. Six separated tentacles curve around its head.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_071_c00.ja: 橙と青の先細りの頭に小さな歯が並ぶ。頭の周りに橙と青の巻いた触手が六本、それぞれ離れている。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_072_c00.en: A tapering orange-and-blue head with rows of tiny teeth is surrounded by separate orange-and-blue curling tentacles. Five separated tentacles curve around its head.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_072_c00.ja: 橙と青の先細りの頭に小さな歯が並ぶ。頭の周りに橙と青の巻いた触手が五本、それぞれ離れている。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_073_c00.en: A tapering orange-and-blue head with rows of tiny teeth is surrounded by separate orange-and-blue curling tentacles. Four separated tentacles curve around its head.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_073_c00.ja: 橙と青の先細りの頭に小さな歯が並ぶ。頭の周りに橙と青の巻いた触手が四本、それぞれ離れている。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_074_c00.en: A tapering orange-and-blue head with rows of tiny teeth is surrounded by separate orange-and-blue curling tentacles. Three separated tentacles curve around its head.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_074_c00.ja: 橙と青の先細りの頭に小さな歯が並ぶ。頭の周りに橙と青の巻いた触手が三本、それぞれ離れている。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_075_c00.en: A tapering orange-and-blue head with rows of tiny teeth is surrounded by separate orange-and-blue curling tentacles. Two separated tentacles curve around its head.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_075_c00.ja: 橙と青の先細りの頭に小さな歯が並ぶ。頭の周りに橙と青の巻いた触手が二本、それぞれ離れている。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_076_c00.en: A tapering orange-and-blue head with rows of tiny teeth is surrounded by separate orange-and-blue curling tentacles. One curled orange-and-blue tentacle lies beside the head.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_076_c00.ja: 橙と青の先細りの頭に小さな歯が並ぶ。頭の横に、橙と青の巻いた触手が一本残る。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_077_c00.en: A copper-brown insect rears with multiple jointed legs, stalklike eyes and a huge open jaw. It has a row of pointed teeth and two long hooked silver pincers.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_077_c00.ja: 銅褐色の昆虫が身を起こす。関節のある脚がいくつもあり、柄のような目と大きく開いたあごがある。尖った歯が一列に並び、長く曲がった銀のはさみが二本突き出す。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_078_c00.en: A floating mass of orange-red flame has two broad raised sides resembling arms. A narrow-eyed face sits above a huge green-rimmed grin with jagged teeth.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_078_c00.ja: 腕のように幅広くせり上がった両側を持つ、赤橙色の浮かぶ炎の塊。細い目の下に緑で縁取った大きな笑い口があり、ぎざぎざの歯が並ぶ。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_079_c00.en: It shows a hunched, almost fully covered shape in layered peach and tan cloth, with a small dark opening and thin fingers at one edge.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_079_c00.ja: 前かがみの姿が、桃と薄茶の重なった布でほぼ覆われる。端に小さな暗い隙間と細い指が見える。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_080_c00.en: It shows a crouched gray-brown ghoul with a long spotted head, hooked claws, a cordlike yellow appendage and sweeping horns curving out from its back.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_080_c00.ja: 灰褐色の鬼がしゃがむ。斑点のある長い頭、鉤爪、ひものような黄色い突起があり、背から曲がった大きな角が伸びる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_081_c00.en: A broad blue-lavender humanoid braces its bent legs and raises thick arms near its head. Red and gold clothing stands out against its muscles.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_081_c00.ja: 肩幅の広い青紫の人型が膝を曲げて踏ん張り、太い腕を頭の近くに上げる。筋肉質な体に赤と金の衣装が目立つ。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_082_c00.en: A detached dark lavender arm curves into a raised rounded wrist. It has a fanged mouth and amber markings.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_082_c00.ja: 体から離れた濃い淡紫の腕が、丸く上げた手首へ向かって曲がる。牙のある口と琥珀色の模様がある。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_083_c00.en: A detached bright magenta arm bends at the wrist and ends in three pointed digits.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_083_c00.ja: 体から離れた鮮やかな赤紫の腕。手首を曲げ、先に尖った指が三本ある。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_084_c00.en: A broad blue turtle-like body crouches on spread claws, with a ridged shell, lowered toothy face and thin tail.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_084_c00.ja: 青い亀のような幅広い体が爪のある足を広げてうずくまる。筋のある甲羅、歯をむいて下げた顔、細い尾がある。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_085_c00.en: The blue turtle-like creature tucks its head and limbs beneath a finely segmented shell.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_085_c00.ja: 青い亀のような生き物が、細かい節のある甲羅の下に頭と手足を引っ込める。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_086_c00.en: A blue turtle-like creature crouches on spread claws inside a bright band of foaming blue water. Its toothy face and ridged shell break the surface.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_086_c00.ja: 青い亀のような生き物が、鮮やかな青い泡立つ水の帯の中で爪のある足を広げてうずくまる。歯をむく顔と筋のある甲羅が水から出る。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_087_c00.en: A spindly mint and slate figure crouches on narrow angular limbs. Pale hornlike branches and sharp points frame a dark face, with thin clawed fingers splayed on each side.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_087_c00.ja: ひょろ長いミント色と青灰色の人型が、細く角張った手足で身を低くする。角のような淡い枝と鋭い突起が暗い顔を囲み、両脇に爪のある細い指を開く。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_088_c00.en: A tall slim figure stands beside a long spear. She has flowing brown hair, pointed pink clothing with gold accents, exposed midriff and legs, and tall magenta boots.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_088_c00.ja: 細身で背の高い人物が長槍のそばに立つ。茶髪がなびき、金の差し色がある桃色の尖った衣装を着ける。腹と脚が露出し、赤紫の長靴は丈が高い。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_089_c00.en: A short, broad figure has a pale angular face, a purple hat and layered violet clothing trimmed with gold. She bends both knees and holds a long straight weapon crosswise.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_089_c00.ja: 背が低く幅広い人物。淡い角張った顔と紫の帽子、金で縁取った紫の重ね着がある。両膝を曲げ、長く真っすぐな武器を横に構える。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_090_c00.en: A small figure in a pointed pink and violet outfit darts forward, a pale blade pointed back above one shoulder. A bright yellow and pink crest projects from her cap.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_090_c00.ja: 桃色と紫の尖った服を着た小柄な人物が前へ飛び出す。片肩の上に淡い刃を後ろ向きに構え、帽子から鮮黄色と桃色の冠飾りが突き出す。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_091_c00.en: A tall figure wears heavy dark blue plate with gold highlights, spiked pauldrons and a high horned helmet. A long blue cape falls around his boots as he folds his arms at his chest.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_091_c00.ja: 背の高い人物。金の差し色がある濃青の重い板金鎧、棘付きの肩甲、角の高い兜を着ける。胸の前で腕を組み、長く青いマントが長靴の周りに垂れる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_092_c00.en: A lithe, pale figure with long bright gold-green hair curls one leg under herself and reaches out. Her narrow gold outfit and hair frame her limbs.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_092_c00.ja: しなやかな色白の人物。明るい金緑色の長い髪があり、片脚を下にたたみながら手を伸ばす。細い金色の衣装と髪が手足を囲む。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_093_c00.en: A lithe, pale figure with long bright gold-green hair curls one leg under herself and reaches out. Her narrow gold outfit and hair frame her limbs. Thick yellow-white whorls of wind wrap her torso and legs and leave her head exposed at the top.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_093_c00.ja: しなやかな色白の人物。明るい金緑色の長い髪があり、片脚を下にたたみながら手を伸ばす。細い金色の衣装と髪が手足を囲む。黄白色の太い風の渦が胴と脚を巻き、頭だけが上に出る。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_094_c00.en: A large jointed doll has a pale violet face, lashes and a small pursed mouth. Two gold bows decorate its hair. Layered rounded body pieces and dark hinges are visible at the arms and legs.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_094_c00.ja: 関節のある大きな人形。淡紫の顔にまつ毛とすぼめた小さな口があり、髪に金のリボンが二つ付く。丸く重なった体の部品と、腕や脚の暗い蝶番が見える。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_095_c00.en: A thin figure with a swept white crest and small angular face wears a violet-gray coat with pink details over narrow, straight trousers. One arm sticks out and the other hangs near the coat.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_095_c00.ja: 小さな角張った顔に後ろへ流れる白い冠毛を持つ細身の人物。桃色の飾りが付いた灰紫の上着に、細く真っすぐなズボン。片腕を突き出し、反対の腕を上着のそばに下げる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_096_c00.en: A lanky skeleton or mechanical frame hunches on two long, jointed legs. The pale round head has pink eyes. Gold, gray and red fittings join the narrow body and arms.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_096_c00.ja: ひょろ長い骸骨か機械の骨組み。関節のある長い二本脚で身をかがめる。淡く丸い頭に桃色の目がある。金、灰、赤の金具が細い胴と腕をつなぐ。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_097_c00.en: A stocky humanoid machine has silver-blue layered plate, square boots, large bronze hands and a squared face with yellow prongs on top.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_097_c00.ja: ずんぐりした人型の機械。重なった銀青色の板金、角張った長靴、大きな青銅色の手と、上に黄色い突起がある角張った顔が見える。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_098_c00.en: A thin figure with a swept white crest and small angular face wears a violet-gray coat with pink details over narrow, straight trousers. One arm sticks out and the other hangs near the coat.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_098_c00.ja: 小さな角張った顔に後ろへ流れる白い冠毛を持つ細身の人物。桃色の飾りが付いた灰紫の上着に、細く真っすぐなズボン。片腕を突き出し、反対の腕を上着のそばに下げる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_099_c00.en: A hulking, horned beast with a grim face, long claws and hooflike feet has a jagged winglike shape behind one shoulder and a skull-shaped marking at the hip. It is gray-blue and muted purple.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_099_c00.ja: 大柄な角のある獣。険しい顔と長い爪、ひづめのような足があり、片肩の後ろにぎざぎざした翼状の形、腰に髑髏の模様がある。青灰色とくすんだ紫。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_099_c01.en: A hulking, horned beast with a grim face, long claws and hooflike feet has a jagged winglike shape behind one shoulder and a skull-shaped marking at the hip. It is purple with yellow horns, teeth and skull trim.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_099_c01.ja: 大柄な角のある獣。険しい顔と長い爪、ひづめのような足があり、片肩の後ろにぎざぎざした翼状の形、腰に髑髏の模様がある。紫の体に黄色の角、歯、髑髏の縁。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_100_c00.en: A wide-eyed humanoid face and horned head crown a sprawling, coiled silhouette. Large claws, flowing locks and a long curved tail show among the coils. It uses green, purple and gold.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_100_c00.ja: 大きな目の人型の顔と角頭の下に、体を広げてとぐろを巻く輪郭がある。巻いた胴の間に大きな爪と流れる髪の房、長く曲がった尾が見える。緑、紫、金色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_100_c01.en: A wide-eyed humanoid face and horned head crown a sprawling, coiled silhouette. Large claws, flowing locks and a long curved tail show among the coils. It uses gold, orange and vivid magenta.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_100_c01.ja: 大きな目の人型の顔と角頭の下に、体を広げてとぐろを巻く輪郭がある。巻いた胴の間に大きな爪と流れる髪の房、長く曲がった尾が見える。金、橙、鮮やかな赤紫。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_101_c00.en: A tall horned figure wears a sweeping flame-red cloak with blue gems or clasps. He opens the cloak and lifts a pale hand, exposing one leg and more of his torso.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_101_c00.ja: 背の高い角のある人物が、青い宝石か留め金がある炎色の赤い外套を着ける。外套を開き、淡い片手を上げると、片脚と胴の一部が現れる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_102_c00.en: A tall horned figure wears a sweeping flame-red cloak with blue gems or clasps. He wraps the cloak close around his body. The eyes, horns and edges of his clothing remain visible.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_102_c00.ja: 背の高い角のある人物が、青い宝石か留め金がある炎色の赤い外套を着ける。外套を体にぴったり巻き、目と角、衣装の縁だけがのぞく。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_103_c00.en: A horned knight in silver-blue armor rides a green-gold horse with a striped mane and tail. He carries a circular shield. The rider holds a curved blade upright beside the shield.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_103_c00.ja: 銀青色の鎧の角兜の騎士が、縞模様のたてがみと尾を持つ緑金色の馬に乗る。丸い盾の横に湾曲した刃を立てて構える。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_104_c00.en: A horned knight in silver-blue armor rides a green-gold horse with a striped mane and tail. He carries a circular shield. The rider extends a curved blade outward and above his helmet.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_104_c00.ja: 銀青色の鎧の角兜の騎士が、縞模様のたてがみと尾を持つ緑金色の馬に乗る。丸い盾を持ち、湾曲した刃を兜より高く外へ伸ばす。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_105_c00.en: A horned knight in silver-blue armor rides a green-gold horse with a striped mane and tail. He carries a circular shield. The rider raises a curved blade across the front of his helmet.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_105_c00.ja: 銀青色の鎧の角兜の騎士が、縞模様のたてがみと尾を持つ緑金色の馬に乗る。丸い盾を持ち、湾曲した刃を兜の前に横ざまに掲げる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_106_c00.en: A huge horned serpent with whiskers forms tall loops. A ridged underbelly and large finlike frills show around the head and neck. The pale violet dragon bends its head down. Red and green trim frame the scales.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_106_c00.ja: 角とひげのある巨大な大蛇が縦に大きな輪を作る。腹に隆起があり、頭と首の周りに大きなひれ状の飾りが見える。淡紫の竜が頭を下に曲げる。鱗の周りに赤と緑の縁がある。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_106_c01.en: A huge horned serpent with whiskers forms tall loops. A ridged underbelly and large finlike frills show around the head and neck. The gold and violet dragon lowers its head, with red trim across its scales.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_106_c01.ja: 角とひげのある巨大な大蛇が縦に大きな輪を作る。腹に隆起があり、頭と首の周りに大きなひれ状の飾りが見える。金と紫の竜が頭を下げる。鱗を横切る赤い縁がある。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_107_c00.en: A huge horned serpent with whiskers forms tall loops. A ridged underbelly and large finlike frills show around the head and neck. The pale violet serpent twists upright.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_107_c00.ja: 角とひげのある巨大な大蛇が縦に大きな輪を作る。腹に隆起があり、頭と首の周りに大きなひれ状の飾りが見える。淡紫の大蛇が体を起こしてねじる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_107_c01.en: A huge horned serpent with whiskers forms tall loops. A ridged underbelly and large finlike frills show around the head and neck. The gold and dark violet serpent twists upright.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_107_c01.ja: 角とひげのある巨大な大蛇が縦に大きな輪を作る。腹に隆起があり、頭と首の周りに大きなひれ状の飾りが見える。金と濃紫の大蛇が体を起こしてねじる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_108_c00.en: A tall carved gray-green door tilts open around a black horizontal maw. Rows of orange pointed teeth line both edges, and reddish cracks stripe the stone.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_108_c00.ja: 彫刻のある背の高い緑灰色の扉が斜めに開き、黒い横長の大口が現れる。両縁に橙の尖った歯が並び、石に赤みのある亀裂が走る。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_109_c00.en: A huge gray-green rectangular wall turns to show one thick side. A distorted face and clawlike shapes are carved into its flat front.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_109_c00.ja: 巨大な緑灰色の四角い壁が向きを変え、厚い側面を見せる。平らな前面にゆがんだ顔と爪のような形が彫られている。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_121_c00.en: A crowned many-armed figure sits cross-legged above hanging pale-blue cloth. Hands hold long narrow weapons around the bare shoulders. A pale gold and pink face looks forward beneath the crown.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_121_c00.ja: 冠をかぶった多腕の人物が、垂れた淡青色の布の上であぐらをかく。むき出しの肩の周りに、細長い武器を持つ手が並ぶ。冠の下の淡金色と桃色の顔は正面を向く。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_122_c00.en: A crowned many-armed figure sits cross-legged above hanging pale-blue cloth. Hands hold long narrow weapons around the bare shoulders. A stern orange-red face looks forward beneath the crown.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_122_c00.ja: 冠をかぶった多腕の人物が、垂れた淡青色の布の上であぐらをかく。むき出しの肩の周りに、細長い武器を持つ手が並ぶ。冠の下の険しい赤橙の顔は正面を向く。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_123_c00.en: A crowned many-armed figure sits cross-legged above hanging pale-blue cloth. Hands hold long narrow weapons around the bare shoulders. A blue face with yellow crown ornaments looks forward.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_123_c00.ja: 冠をかぶった多腕の人物が、垂れた淡青色の布の上であぐらをかく。むき出しの肩の周りに、細長い武器を持つ手が並ぶ。黄色の冠飾りがある青い顔が正面を向く。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_124_c00.en: A long pale serpent coils in a wide loop. Its narrow scaled snout droops at one side beneath thin curling whiskers, and a striped ridge follows the back of the head. It has muted gray, mauve and pale green bands.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_124_c00.ja: 淡い大蛇が大きく輪を描く。細く鱗のある鼻面が片側で垂れ、その上に細く巻いたひげがあり、縞模様の隆起が頭の後ろに沿う。くすんだ灰、灰紫、淡緑の帯。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_124_c01.en: A long pale serpent coils in a wide loop. Its narrow scaled snout droops at one side beneath thin curling whiskers, and a striped ridge follows the back of the head. It has brighter cyan and lavender shading.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_124_c01.ja: 淡い大蛇が大きく輪を描く。細く鱗のある鼻面が片側で垂れ、その上に細く巻いたひげがあり、縞模様の隆起が頭の後ろに沿う。明るめの水色と淡紫の陰。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_125_c00.en: A glossy dark-blue sphere reflects a white point of light near its upper edge. Small pale specks and a thin bright equatorial seam stand out against the sphere.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_125_c00.ja: つやのある濃青色の球。上端近くに白い一点の光を反射し、小さな淡色の斑点と赤道の細い明るい継ぎ目が目立つ。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_126_c00.en: A glossy dark-blue sphere reflects a white point of light near its upper edge. The plain sphere has a violet edge.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_126_c00.ja: つやのある濃青色の球。上端近くに白い一点の光を反射し、模様の少ない球の縁が紫色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_127_c00.en: A pale floating figure shadows most of its body in a long ragged violet robe. Its two narrow arms stretch upward and out. A dark crown or collar with gold stripes frames the face.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_127_c00.ja: 淡色の浮かぶ人物。体の大半をぼろぼろに垂れる長い紫のローブが影に隠す。細い両腕を上と外へ伸ばし、金の縞のある暗い冠か襟が顔を囲む。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_128_c00.en: It shows a huge flowing blue mass with long swept-back ridges, narrow red-orange slits and a curled glowing opening near the front.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_128_c00.ja: 巨大な青い流れる塊。後ろに流れる長い隆起と赤橙の細い隙間があり、前の近くに巻いた光る開口部がある。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_129_c00.en: It is an enormous gray skeletal mass with fanged jaws, long branching spines, red channels in the riblike body and vivid blue and red circular cores.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_129_c00.ja: 巨大な灰色の骨格の塊。牙のあるあごと枝分かれする長い棘、肋骨のような胴に赤い溝、鮮やかな青と赤の丸い核がある。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_132_c00.en: A large silver-blue humanoid machine has a narrow horned head, blocky boots and gauntlets, orange joints and layered metal plates across the torso.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_132_c00.ja: 大型の銀青色の人型機械。細い角付きの頭、角張った長靴と籠手、橙色の関節があり、胴に金属板が重なる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_133_c00.en: A rounded orange-yellow egg is mottled with green blotches.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_133_c00.ja: 丸い橙黄色の卵に不規則な緑の斑点がある。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_134_c00.en: A rounded orange-yellow egg is mottled with green blotches. A jagged vertical split runs down its front.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_134_c00.ja: 丸い橙黄色の卵に不規則な緑の斑点がある。前にぎざぎざの縦の割れ目が走る。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_135_c00.en: A round yellow bird has an upright feather crest, blue eye, curved bill, orange feet and raised tail feathers. Its body is upright with both feet down.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_135_c00.ja: 丸い黄色い鳥に立った冠羽、青い目、曲がったくちばし、橙色の足と上げた尾羽がある。両足を着いて体を起こす。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_136_c00.en: A round yellow bird has an upright feather crest, blue eye, curved bill, orange feet and raised tail feathers. The bird leans forward in a run with both feet extended.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_136_c00.ja: 丸い黄色い鳥に立った冠羽、青い目、曲がったくちばし、橙色の足と上げた尾羽がある。走るように前へ傾き、両足を伸ばす。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_137_c00.en: A blue-white, winged humanoid floats with pointed head ornaments and a curling ribbonlike lower half. It spreads its arms near a few yellow sparks.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_137_c00.ja: 青白い翼のある人型が浮く。頭に尖った飾りが付き、下半身はリボンのように巻く。黄色い火花の近くで両腕を広げる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_138_c00.en: A blue-white, winged humanoid floats with pointed head ornaments and a curling ribbonlike lower half. It extends one arm toward a bright star-shaped flash.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_138_c00.ja: 青白い翼のある人型が浮く。頭に尖った飾りが付き、下半身はリボンのように巻く。明るい星形の光に片腕を伸ばす。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_139_c00.en: A crouching green creature has heavy forelimbs, a long toothy muzzle, purple claws and two sweeping red-orange arcs above it.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_139_c00.ja: 緑の生き物がうずくまる。太い前脚、歯をむく長い鼻面、紫の爪があり、頭上に赤橙色の大きな弧が二本走る。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_140_c00.en: A crouching green creature has heavy forelimbs, a long toothy muzzle, purple claws and two sweeping red-orange arcs above it. Bright orange streaks radiate outward from the creature.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_140_c00.ja: 緑の生き物がうずくまる。太い前脚、歯をむく長い鼻面、紫の爪があり、頭上に赤橙色の大きな弧が二本走る。体から鮮橙色の光の筋が放射状に広がる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_141_c00.en: A hunched elderly figure has a very long white-gray beard, exposed nose and bald crown, and a dark blue and olive cloak. He holds a long blue staff crosswise.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_141_c00.ja: 背を丸めた老人物。白灰色のとても長いひげと、むき出しの鼻、禿げた頭頂があり、濃青とオリーブ色の外套を着ける。青い長杖を横に構える。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_142_c00.en: A hunched elderly figure has a very long white-gray beard, exposed nose and bald crown, and a dark blue and olive cloak. He raises a blue staff with a tiny pale-blue shape or glow at the tip.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_142_c00.ja: 背を丸めた老人物。白灰色のとても長いひげと、むき出しの鼻、禿げた頭頂があり、濃青とオリーブ色の外套を着ける。青い杖を上げると、先に小さな淡青色の形か光がある。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_143_c00.en: Three small glowing figures are stacked in a vertical line. Each has yellow and red markings and blue-green wings. All three spread similarly broad wings.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_143_c00.ja: 光る小さな姿が三つ、縦一列に並ぶ。それぞれに黄色と赤の模様、青緑の翼があり、三つとも同じように広い翼を広げる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_144_c00.en: Three small glowing figures are stacked in a vertical line. Each has yellow and red markings and blue-green wings. The top figure spreads long wings. The other two pull theirs in.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_144_c00.ja: 光る小さな姿が三つ、縦一列に並ぶ。それぞれに黄色と赤の模様、青緑の翼がある。一番上は長い翼を広げ、他の二つは翼をたたむ。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_145_c00.en: A round pale pink pig has a projecting square snout, small pointed ears, short legs and an upright curled tail.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_145_c00.ja: 丸い淡桃色のブタ。角張った鼻先が突き出し、小さく尖った耳、短い脚、上に巻いた尾がある。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_146_c00.en: A small pale figure wears green hair or a pointed green hood with a gold ornament, a blue and gold top and pink boots. One arm lifts at her side.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_146_c00.ja: 小柄で淡い顔に、緑の髪か金の飾りが付いた尖った緑の頭巾がある。青と金の上着と桃色の長靴を着け、片腕を脇に上げる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_147_c00.en: A pale blond man wears a red cap with a white feather, green scarf and cloak, and white sleeves over red and brown clothing.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_147_c00.ja: 色白の金髪の男。白羽根の赤い帽子、緑のスカーフと外套、白い袖を着け、赤と茶の衣装が下に見える。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_148_c00.en: A fighter has a dragon-shaped blue helmet with a red mark, pointed blue shoulder guards and exposed hands. The fighter stands in profile.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_148_c00.ja: 竜をかたどった青い兜に赤い模様があり、尖った青い肩甲を着け、手を出している戦士。横向きに立つ。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_148_c01.en: A fighter has a dragon-shaped blue helmet with a red mark, pointed blue shoulder guards and exposed hands. The fighter faces forward with bent arms.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_148_c01.ja: 竜をかたどった青い兜に赤い模様があり、尖った青い肩甲を着け、手を出している戦士。正面を向いて両腕を曲げる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_148_c03.en: A fighter has a dragon-shaped blue helmet with a red mark, pointed blue shoulder guards and exposed hands. The fighter leans down behind a pair of long blue points.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_148_c03.ja: 竜をかたどった青い兜に赤い模様があり、尖った青い肩甲を着け、手を出している戦士。青い長い尖端二本の後ろに身をかがめる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_149_c00.en: A fighter wears dark indigo armor, a swept helmet with a narrow yellow eye slit, and yellow accents at the feet. The fighter braces in a ready stance.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_149_c00.ja: 暗い藍色の鎧の戦士。後ろに流れる兜には細い黄色の目穴があり、足元にも黄色の差し色がある。踏ん張って構える。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_149_c01.en: A fighter wears dark indigo armor, a swept helmet with a narrow yellow eye slit, and yellow accents at the feet. The fighter thrusts a large silver sword straight forward.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_149_c01.ja: 暗い藍色の鎧の戦士。後ろに流れる兜には細い黄色の目穴があり、足元にも黄色の差し色がある。大きな銀の剣を真っすぐ前へ突き出す。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_149_c02.en: A fighter wears dark indigo armor, a swept helmet with a narrow yellow eye slit, and yellow accents at the feet. The fighter lifts a large silver sword diagonally across the body.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_149_c02.ja: 暗い藍色の鎧の戦士。後ろに流れる兜には細い黄色の目穴があり、足元にも黄色の差し色がある。大きな銀の剣を胴の前に斜めに掲げる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_150_c00.en: A bare-chested fighter has a shaved crown, trailing dark braid, dark goatee, blue wrist wraps and red trousers with yellow trim. He stands upright with his fists raised.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_150_c00.ja: 上半身裸の格闘家。頭頂を剃り、暗い長い編み髪とあごひげがある。青い手首の巻き布と黄色で縁取った赤いズボンを着ける。両拳を上げてまっすぐ立つ。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_150_c01.en: A bare-chested fighter has a shaved crown, trailing dark braid, dark goatee, blue wrist wraps and red trousers with yellow trim. He takes a wide side-on stance, with his back leg extended.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_150_c01.ja: 上半身裸の格闘家。頭頂を剃り、暗い長い編み髪とあごひげがある。青い手首の巻き布と黄色で縁取った赤いズボンを着ける。横を向いて大股に構え、後ろ脚を伸ばす。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_150_c02.en: A bare-chested fighter has a shaved crown, trailing dark braid, dark goatee, blue wrist wraps and red trousers with yellow trim. He shifts the rear leg and keeps his fists raised in a wide side-on stance.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_150_c02.ja: 上半身裸の格闘家。頭頂を剃り、暗い長い編み髪とあごひげがある。青い手首の巻き布と黄色で縁取った赤いズボンを着ける。大股の横向きの構えで両拳を上げたまま、後ろ脚を動かす。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_150_c03.en: A bare-chested fighter has a shaved crown, trailing dark braid, dark goatee, blue wrist wraps and red trousers with yellow trim. He extends a leg in a high side kick.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_150_c03.ja: 上半身裸の格闘家。頭頂を剃り、暗い長い編み髪とあごひげがある。青い手首の巻き布と黄色で縁取った赤いズボンを着ける。片脚を高く横へ伸ばして蹴る。

Enemy appearance mn_ff4_152_c03.en: A small, hunched figure has a long pointed cap, a hooked nose, a large pointed ear and a raised clawlike hand. The other hand wields a short curved blade. It wears orange-red with a gray face and hand.
Enemy appearance mn_ff4_152_c03.ja: 小柄な人物が背を丸める。長い尖り帽子に鉤鼻、大きな尖り耳があり、爪のような片手を上げる。もう片手に短く曲がった刃を持つ。服は赤橙色で、顔と手は灰色。

Field appearance mo_ff4_b004_c00.en: A tall faceted crystal has a white core and cyan and deep blue faces.
Field appearance mo_ff4_b004_c00.ja: 背の高い多面の水晶。白い中心と水色や濃青の面がある。

Field appearance mo_ff4_b007_c00.en: A tall faceted crystal has a white core and gold and red faces.
Field appearance mo_ff4_b007_c00.ja: 背の高い多面の水晶。白い中心と金色や赤い面がある。

Field appearance mo_ff4_e016_c00.en: A white rounded bubble shows three red Z-shaped marks.
Field appearance mo_ff4_e016_c00.ja: 丸い白い吹き出しに赤いＺ形の印が三つ並ぶ。

Field appearance mo_ff4_e101_c00.en: Icy-blue serif lettering reads “THE END.” Existing text can convey the words.
Field appearance mo_ff4_e101_c00.ja: 氷のような青のセリフ体で「THE END」と表示される。文字は既存の読み上げでも伝えられる。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n001_c00.en: A bulky navy armored figure has branching gold horns, gold shoulder bars and a narrow dark visor. A long blue-violet cape hangs from a gold border across the armor's back.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n001_c00.ja: ごつい紺色の鎧の人物。枝分かれする金の角、肩の金の帯、細く暗い面がある。鎧の背の金縁から長い青紫のマントが垂れる。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n002_c00.en: A little rounded orange creature has two high ear-like points, a short square muzzle, dark eyes and small pale paws.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n002_c00.ja: 橙色の丸い小さな生き物。耳のような高い突起が二本あり、短く角張った鼻先と暗い目、淡い小さな足がある。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n003_c00.en: A short-haired pale figure wears heavy shoulder plates with contrasting cuffs and a long cape. It has auburn hair, gold trim and violet clothing and cape.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n003_c00.ja: 短髪で色白の人物。重そうな肩甲、色の違う袖口、長いマントを着ける。赤褐色の髪、金の縁、紫の衣装とマント。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n003_c01.en: A short-haired pale figure wears heavy shoulder plates with contrasting cuffs and a long cape. It has brown hair and a blue cape with gold shoulders.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n003_c01.ja: 短髪で色白の人物。重そうな肩甲、色の違う袖口、長いマントを着ける。茶髪に青いマントと金の肩。
