Field appearance mo_ff4_n013_c04.ja: 背の低い人物が頭巾に床まで届く外套を着ける。影に隠れた顔で二つの目が光る。赤の外套と明るい黄色い目。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n013_c05.en: A short hooded figure wears a floor-length gold cloak. Two bright red eyes shine from its shadowed face.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n013_c05.ja: 背の低い人物が頭巾に床まで届く外套を着ける。影に隠れた顔で二つの目が光る。金色の外套と明るい赤い目。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n013_c06.en: A short hooded figure wears a floor-length pale blue cloak. Two bright yellow eyes shine from its shadowed face.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n013_c06.ja: 背の低い人物が頭巾に床まで届く外套を着ける。影に隠れた顔で二つの目が光る。淡い青の外套と明るい黄色い目。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n013_c07.en: A short hooded figure wears a floor-length orange cloak. Two bright yellow eyes shine from its shadowed face.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n013_c07.ja: 背の低い人物が頭巾に床まで届く外套を着ける。影に隠れた顔で二つの目が光る。橙の外套と明るい黄色い目。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n014_c00.en: A small upward-looking figure wears two hair ornaments over a short skirt. It has indigo hair and a blue-violet outfit.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n014_c00.ja: 小柄で上を見上げ、髪飾りを二つ付け、短いスカートをはく。藍色の髪と青紫の衣装。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n014_c01.en: A small upward-looking figure wears two hair ornaments over a short skirt. It has shoulder-length brown hair and a pink outfit.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n014_c01.ja: 小柄で上を見上げ、髪飾りを二つ付け、短いスカートをはく。肩までの茶髪と桃色の衣装。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n014_c02.en: A small upward-looking figure wears two hair ornaments over a short skirt. It wears a light violet cap with a gold fastener and white and pink clothing.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n014_c02.ja: 小柄で上を見上げ、髪飾りを二つ付け、短いスカートをはく。金の留め金のある淡紫の帽子、白と桃色の衣装。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n015_c00.en: A short robed humanoid wears a very wide horned gold and purple helmet. Yellow eyes peer out from a shadowed face above a long brown-gold jaw trim and violet cape.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n015_c00.ja: 背の低いローブ姿の人型が角のある金と紫のとても幅広い兜をかぶる。茶金色の長い顎飾りと紫のマントの上で、影の顔から黄色い目がのぞく。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n016_c00.en: A narrow pale-faced figure wears a tall dark blue headdress, blond hair at its sides and a long lavender and white robe with gold shoulder and wrist trim.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n016_c00.ja: 顔の細い色白の人物。背の高い濃青の頭飾りの脇に金髪が見え、金の肩と手首飾りのある淡紫と白の長いローブを着ける。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n017_c00.en: A short hunched figure has wild pale gray hair, a little dark eye band and a long cream-gray coat. Violet and yellow details show at the front.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n017_c00.ja: 小柄な人物が身をかがめる。逆立つ淡灰の髪、小さな暗い目の帯、クリーム灰色の長い外套がある。前に紫と黄色の差し色が見える。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n018_c00.en: A pale figure wears a floor-length blue or mauve gown, pale hanging sleeves and a small vivid head ornament. It has a violet and gold hood and magenta dress.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n018_c00.ja: 色白の人物。床まで届く青か灰紫のドレスに、淡い垂れ袖と小さく鮮やかな頭飾りを着ける。紫と金の頭巾に赤紫のドレス。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n018_c01.en: A pale figure wears a floor-length blue or mauve gown, pale hanging sleeves and a small vivid head ornament. It has brown hair with gold trim and a navy dress.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n018_c01.ja: 色白の人物。床まで届く青か灰紫のドレスに、淡い垂れ袖と小さく鮮やかな頭飾りを着ける。金の縁を付けた茶髪に紺のドレス。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n018_c02.en: A pale figure wears a floor-length blue or mauve gown, pale hanging sleeves and a small vivid head ornament. It has lavender and pink hair or headwear and a mauve and blue dress with warm trim.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n018_c02.ja: 色白の人物。床まで届く青か灰紫のドレスに、淡い垂れ袖と小さく鮮やかな頭飾りを着ける。淡紫と桃の髪か頭飾りに、暖色で縁取った灰紫と青のドレス。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n019_c00.en: A small round hovering body has two sharply slanted eyes, a broad many-toothed grin and three detached pale glints over its head. It is blue-violet.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n019_c00.ja: 丸い小さな体が浮く。鋭いつり目二つと歯の多い幅広い笑い口があり、頭上に離れた淡い光が三つ浮く。青紫色。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n019_c01.en: A small round hovering body has two sharply slanted eyes, a broad many-toothed grin and three detached pale glints over its head. It is bright orange-red.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n019_c01.ja: 丸い小さな体が浮く。鋭いつり目二つと歯の多い幅広い笑い口があり、頭上に離れた淡い光が三つ浮く。鮮やかな赤橙色。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n020_c00.en: A blocky gray and orange flamelike creature has a dark angry brow, bared white teeth and jagged pointed edges.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n020_c00.ja: 灰色と橙の、角張った炎のような生き物。暗い険しい眉、むき出しの白い歯、ぎざぎざの尖った縁がある。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n021_c00.en: A small blue ridged shell curves down toward a pale-blue lowered head or mouth, with little side flaps or feet.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n021_c00.ja: 筋のある青い小さな殻が、低く下がった淡青の頭か口に向かって曲がる。脇に小さなひれか足がある。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n022_c00.en: A pale purple ear-like helmet or crest flares beside a shaded face. A blue-violet robe with red and white shoulder trim spreads along the ground.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n022_c00.ja: 影のかかった顔の脇に、耳のような淡紫の兜か冠飾りが大きく広がる。赤と白の肩飾りがある青紫のローブが地面に広がる。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n023_c00.en: A gaunt gray and teal creature has long thin clawed limbs, a narrow dark face and a bright purple spike and collar details.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n023_c00.ja: やせた灰色と青緑の生き物。長く細い爪の手足と暗い細顔、鮮紫色の棘と襟飾りがある。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n024_c00.en: A segmented violet hand or limb has four narrow fingertips with pale yellow ends. From the side the wrist stretches into a long bent shape.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n024_c00.ja: 節のある紫の手か手足。細い指先が四本あり、先端は淡黄色。横から見ると手首が長く曲がる。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n025_c00.en: A little rigid dark-armored figure wears magenta and blue armor with a horned helmet and dark open face and chest areas. Small yellow eyes show inside the head.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n025_c00.ja: 小柄で硬い暗色の鎧姿。赤紫と青の鎧と角兜を着ける。顔と胸が暗く開き、頭の中に小さな黄色い目が見える。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n026_c00.en: Two closely folded small poses show pale hands or a face beside a rounded body. It uses violet clothing and a red-orange tip.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n026_c00.ja: 丸い胴のそばに淡い手か顔が見える。小さくきつく体をたたんだ姿が二通りある。紫の衣装で先端は赤橙色。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n026_c01.en: Two closely folded small poses show pale hands or a face beside a rounded body. It is warm brown with a yellow tip.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n026_c01.ja: 丸い胴のそばに淡い手か顔が見える。小さくきつく体をたたんだ姿が二通りある。暖かい茶色で先端は黄色。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n027_c00.en: A tiny pale hand-shaped form stands upright between two scattered cyan marks.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n027_c00.ja: 手の形をしたごく小さな淡色のものが、水色の離れた印二つの間に立つ。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n028_c00.en: A large round yellow-orange bird sits amid loose feathers. It has a large golden beak, a prominent blue eye, a brown foot lifted forward and a little pale glint above.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n028_c00.ja: 大きく丸い黄橙色の鳥が、散った羽の中に座る。大きな金のくちばし、目立つ青い目、前に上げた茶色い足と、上に小さな淡い光がある。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n029_c00.en: A pale figure has shoulder-length brown hair, large blue eyes, a yellow waist band and a short bright gold dress.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n029_c00.ja: 色白の人物。肩までの茶髪、大きな青い目、黄色い腰帯と丈の短い鮮金色のドレスがある。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n030_c00.en: A compact figure has two dark brown tied bunches or panels and bright yellow eyes against a shaded face. A little pink and gold outfit shows beneath.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n030_c00.ja: 小柄な人物。両脇に暗褐色の結んだ髪の房か板があり、影の顔に鮮黄色の目が見える。下に小さな桃色と金の服。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n031_c00.en: A low orange shape has a thin curved taper reaching up to one side with a pale tip, like a lick of fire rising from a glowing puddle.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n031_c00.ja: 低い橙色の形。片側から淡色の先が付いた細い曲線が伸び、光る水たまりから上がる火の舌のように見える。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n032_c00.en: A toy-like figure has rounded bunches at both sides of its head, a center ornament and a broad short dress. It has rust-red hair, a gold bow and a yellow dress.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n032_c00.ja: おもちゃのような人物。頭の両側に丸い髪の房、中央に飾りがあり、幅広い短いドレスを着ける。さび赤色の髪、金のリボン、黄色いドレス。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n032_c01.en: A toy-like figure has rounded bunches at both sides of its head, a center ornament and a broad short dress. It has purple hair, a blue bow and a blue dress.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n032_c01.ja: おもちゃのような人物。頭の両側に丸い髪の房、中央に飾りがあり、幅広い短いドレスを着ける。紫の髪、青いリボン、青いドレス。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n033_c00.en: Two thin orange and gold curling streaks stand apart, edged in black with a pale glint beside them.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n033_c00.ja: 橙と金の細い巻いた光の筋が二本離れて立つ。黒い縁があり、横に淡い光が見える。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n034_c00.en: A pale slender figure has long yellow-green hair, clear blue eyes and a short gold-colored outfit. Thick pointed strands curl around her sides.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n034_c00.ja: 淡い顔の細身の人物。長い黄緑の髪、澄んだ青い目、短い金色の衣装がある。太く尖った房が脇で巻く。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n035_c00.en: A little pale fairy has a wing-shaped headdress and long upward flaring wings. It uses green, yellow, cyan and blue.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n035_c00.ja: 淡色の小さな妖精。翼形の頭飾りと、上に向けて広がる長い翼がある。緑、黄、水色、青の色合い。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n035_c01.en: A little pale fairy has a wing-shaped headdress and long upward flaring wings. It uses lavender, mint and pale blue.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n035_c01.ja: 淡色の小さな妖精。翼形の頭飾りと、上に向けて広がる長い翼がある。淡紫、ミント、淡青の色合い。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n036_c00.en: A small ponytailed figure tips horizontally with arms and hair trailing. It is gray and white.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n036_c00.ja: ポニーテールの小柄な人物が横に傾き、腕と髪が後ろへ流れる。灰色と白。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n036_c01.en: A small ponytailed figure tips horizontally with arms and hair trailing. It shows brown hair, a pale shirt and a bright red trailing cloth.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n036_c01.ja: ポニーテールの小柄な人物が横に傾き、腕と髪が後ろへ流れる。茶髪と淡い上着に鮮赤の流れる布。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n037_c00.en: A small blond head bends almost flat above a dark red and charcoal bundled body.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n037_c00.ja: 小さな金髪の頭が、暗赤色と黒灰色の布で包んだ体の上でほぼ水平に曲がる。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n038_c00.en: Short knotted streaks of orange and gold glow around a vivid blue center. The edges are a pale flame orange.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n038_c00.ja: 鮮やかな青い中心を、橙と金の短い結んだような筋が光って囲む。炎のような淡橙色。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n038_c01.en: Short knotted streaks of orange and gold glow around a vivid blue center. It has deeper rust and red edges.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n038_c01.ja: 鮮やかな青い中心を、橙と金の短い結んだような筋が光って囲む。縁が濃いさび色と赤。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n039_c00.en: A tall slender blue armored figure has round raised shoulder domes, a recessed dark face, narrow claws and long plated legs.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n039_c00.ja: 背の高い細身の青い鎧姿。丸く盛り上がる肩、くぼんだ暗い顔、細い爪、板に覆われた長い脚がある。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n040_c00.en: A small pointed pale purple shape breaks through a thin white horizontal line, with a few pale flecks to the left.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n040_c00.ja: 尖った小さな淡紫の形が細い白の横線を突き破り、左に淡い小片がいくつか飛ぶ。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n041_c00.en: A compact red and violet dragon has long horns, several broad jagged wings, a low toothy snout and thick limbs that curl around the body.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n041_c00.ja: 小柄な赤と紫の竜。長い角、広くぎざぎざしたいくつかの翼、歯をむいた低い鼻面、胴を巻く太い手足がある。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n042_c00.en: A long pale serpentine creature is visible in separate arches. Violet ridges peak over pale blue splashes, with a narrow spiked head at one end.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n042_c00.ja: ヘビのように長い淡色の生き物が、離れた弧をいくつも描く。青白いしぶきから紫の隆起が出て、一方に棘のある細い頭がある。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n043_c00.en: A triangular white wave or spray rises above a horizontal lower edge and breaks into a detached pale dot.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n043_c00.ja: 三角の白波か水しぶきが、水平な下縁から上がり、離れた淡い点に分かれる。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n044_c00.en: A tilted small figure with a trailing ponytail extends a pale arm forward. It is gray-white.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n044_c00.ja: ポニーテールをなびかせた小柄な人物が斜めに傾き、淡い腕を前へ伸ばす。灰白色。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n044_c01.en: A tilted small figure with a trailing ponytail extends a pale arm forward. It has brown hair and a short bright green cloth trail.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n044_c01.ja: ポニーテールをなびかせた小柄な人物が斜めに傾き、淡い腕を前へ伸ばす。茶髪で小さな鮮緑の布が後ろに流れる。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n101_c00.en: A compact soldier wears a round helmet, matching tunic with a colored waist stripe and short armored boots. It has a bronze helmet and magenta and violet clothes.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n101_c00.ja: 小柄な兵士。丸い兜に合う上着に腰の色帯があり、短い甲のある長靴を着ける。青銅色の兜に赤紫と紫の服。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n101_c01.en: A compact soldier wears a round helmet, matching tunic with a colored waist stripe and short armored boots. It has a steel helmet and blue and gold clothes.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n101_c01.ja: 小柄な兵士。丸い兜に合う上着に腰の色帯があり、短い甲のある長靴を着ける。鋼の兜に青と金の服。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n101_c02.en: A compact soldier wears a round helmet, matching tunic with a colored waist stripe and short armored boots. It has a gold helmet and red and gold clothes.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n101_c02.ja: 小柄な兵士。丸い兜に合う上着に腰の色帯があり、短い甲のある長靴を着ける。金の兜に赤と金の服。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n102_c00.en: A short figure with swept hair and dark eyes wears a simple long-sleeved tunic and narrowly cut trousers. It has rust-brown hair and plum clothes.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n102_c00.ja: 流した髪と暗い目の背の低い人物。素朴な長袖の上着と細身のズボンを着ける。さび茶の髪にすもも色の服。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n102_c01.en: A short figure with swept hair and dark eyes wears a simple long-sleeved tunic and narrowly cut trousers. It has brown hair and slate-blue clothes.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n102_c01.ja: 流した髪と暗い目の背の低い人物。素朴な長袖の上着と細身のズボンを着ける。茶髪に青灰色の服。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n102_c02.en: A short figure with swept hair and dark eyes wears a simple long-sleeved tunic and narrowly cut trousers. It has yellow-blond hair, a deep red top and brown trousers.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n102_c02.ja: 流した髪と暗い目の背の低い人物。素朴な長袖の上着と細身のズボンを着ける。金髪に濃赤色の上着と茶色のズボン。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n103_c00.en: A pale woman has pulled-back hair, two colorful ties and short pale sleeves over a long dress. It has purple-pink hair and skirt with green ties.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n103_c00.ja: 色白の女性。髪を後ろで結び、色の付いた結び飾りが二つある。長いドレスの袖は短く淡色。桃紫の髪とスカートに緑の結び飾り。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n103_c01.en: A pale woman has pulled-back hair, two colorful ties and short pale sleeves over a long dress. It wears violet and gold.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n103_c01.ja: 色白の女性。髪を後ろで結び、色の付いた結び飾りが二つある。長いドレスの袖は短く淡色。紫と金の装い。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n103_c02.en: A pale woman has pulled-back hair, two colorful ties and short pale sleeves over a long dress. It has copper hair and red clothing with yellow ties.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n103_c02.ja: 色白の女性。髪を後ろで結び、色の付いた結び飾りが二つある。長いドレスの袖は短く淡色。銅色の髪と赤い服に黄色い結び飾り。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n104_c00.en: A short old figure wears a pointed cap and thick robe around a long beard. It wears purple with a white beard.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n104_c00.ja: 背の低い老人物。尖り帽子と厚いローブが長いひげを囲む。紫の衣装に白ひげ。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n104_c01.en: A short old figure wears a pointed cap and thick robe around a long beard. It wears dark blue with a rust beard.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n104_c01.ja: 背の低い老人物。尖り帽子と厚いローブが長いひげを囲む。濃青の衣装にさび色のひげ。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n104_c02.en: A short old figure wears a pointed cap and thick robe around a long beard. It wears pink with a yellow beard.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n104_c02.ja: 背の低い老人物。尖り帽子と厚いローブが長いひげを囲む。桃色の衣装に黄色のひげ。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n104_c03.en: A short old figure wears a pointed cap and thick robe around a long beard. It wears dark teal with a brown beard.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n104_c03.ja: 背の低い老人物。尖り帽子と厚いローブが長いひげを囲む。濃青緑の衣装に茶のひげ。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n104_c04.en: A short old figure wears a pointed cap and thick robe around a long beard. It has an olive-gray muted face, beard and robes.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n104_c04.ja: 背の低い老人物。尖り帽子と厚いローブが長いひげを囲む。くすんだ緑灰色の顔、ひげ、ローブ。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n105_c00.en: A round-faced figure has hair in a large bun, long sleeves and a matching long robe. It has silver hair and purple robes.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n105_c00.ja: 丸顔の人物。大きなお団子に髪を結い、長い袖の同色の長衣を着ける。銀髪に紫のローブ。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n105_c01.en: A round-faced figure has hair in a large bun, long sleeves and a matching long robe. It has brown hair and blue robes.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n105_c01.ja: 丸顔の人物。大きなお団子に髪を結い、長い袖の同色の長衣を着ける。茶髪に青いローブ。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n105_c02.en: A round-faced figure has hair in a large bun, long sleeves and a matching long robe. It has gold hair and red robes.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n105_c02.ja: 丸顔の人物。大きなお団子に髪を結い、長い袖の同色の長衣を着ける。金髪に赤いローブ。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n105_c03.en: A round-faced figure has hair in a large bun, long sleeves and a matching long robe. It has a pale olive-gray body and robe.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n105_c03.ja: 丸顔の人物。大きなお団子に髪を結い、長い袖の同色の長衣を着ける。体とローブは淡い緑灰色。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n106_c00.en: A small childlike figure has a big fringe, cropped clothing and short boots. It has magenta hair and a gold shirt with blue boots.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n106_c00.ja: 子供のような小柄な人物。大きな前髪、丈の短い服と短い長靴がある。赤紫の髪、金色の上着、青い長靴。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n106_c01.en: A small childlike figure has a big fringe, cropped clothing and short boots. It has violet hair and gray clothes with red boots.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n106_c01.ja: 子供のような小柄な人物。大きな前髪、丈の短い服と短い長靴がある。紫の髪と灰色の服、赤い長靴。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n106_c02.en: A small childlike figure has a big fringe, cropped clothing and short boots. It has brown hair, pale purple clothes and pink boots.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n106_c02.ja: 子供のような小柄な人物。大きな前髪、丈の短い服と短い長靴がある。茶髪と淡紫の服、桃色の長靴。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n107_c00.en: A young figure with two tied bunches wears a short dress with squared pale cuffs. It uses violet hair and red clothing.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n107_c00.ja: 髪を二つの房に結んだ若い人物。淡色の角張った袖口がある短いドレスを着る。紫の髪に赤いドレス。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n107_c01.en: A young figure with two tied bunches wears a short dress with squared pale cuffs. It uses dark violet hair and burnt red clothing.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n107_c01.ja: 髪を二つの房に結んだ若い人物。淡色の角張った袖口がある短いドレスを着る。濃紫の髪に焦げた赤のドレス。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n107_c02.en: A young figure with two tied bunches wears a short dress with squared pale cuffs. It uses rust hair and gold clothing.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n107_c02.ja: 髪を二つの房に結んだ若い人物。淡色の角張った袖口がある短いドレスを着る。さび色の髪に金色のドレス。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n107_c03.en: A young figure with two tied bunches wears a short dress with squared pale cuffs. It uses sandy blond hair and pale blue clothing.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n107_c03.ja: 髪を二つの房に結んだ若い人物。淡色の角張った袖口がある短いドレスを着る。砂色がかった金髪に淡青のドレス。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n109_c00.en: A petite figure has hair swept under a large side bow and a short fitted outfit that leaves pale arms and legs exposed. It uses purple hair, orange bow and violet clothes.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n109_c00.ja: 小柄な人物。髪を流して片側の大きなリボンで留める。丈の短い体に沿う服から淡色の手足が出る。紫の髪、橙のリボン、紫の服。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n109_c01.en: A petite figure has hair swept under a large side bow and a short fitted outfit that leaves pale arms and legs exposed. It uses indigo hair, pink bow and blue clothes.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n109_c01.ja: 小柄な人物。髪を流して片側の大きなリボンで留める。丈の短い体に沿う服から淡色の手足が出る。藍色の髪、桃色のリボン、青い服。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n109_c02.en: A petite figure has hair swept under a large side bow and a short fitted outfit that leaves pale arms and legs exposed. It uses brown hair, yellow bow and red clothes.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n109_c02.ja: 小柄な人物。髪を流して片側の大きなリボンで留める。丈の短い体に沿う服から淡色の手足が出る。茶髪、黄色のリボン、赤い服。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n110_c00.en: A small figure wears a short cloak over a sleeveless tunic and has long hair gathered with a tie. It has bright blond hair, a plum cloak with pale trim and green clothes.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n110_c00.ja: 小柄な人物。袖なしの上着の上に短い外套を羽織り、長い髪を結んでまとめる。明るい金髪に淡い縁のすもも色の外套、緑の服。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n110_c01.en: A small figure wears a short cloak over a sleeveless tunic and has long hair gathered with a tie. It has brown hair tied with blue and wears a blue and pale coat over ochre trousers.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n110_c01.ja: 小柄な人物。袖なしの上着の上に短い外套を羽織り、長い髪を結んでまとめる。茶髪を青で結び、黄土色のズボンの上に青と淡色の上着を着ける。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n112_c00.en: A short armored figure has a tall horned helmet, dark face with yellow eyes and short boots. It uses violet and bright gold.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n112_c00.ja: 短身の鎧姿。高い角兜と黄色い目のある暗い顔、短い長靴がある。紫と鮮金色。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n112_c01.en: A short armored figure has a tall horned helmet, dark face with yellow eyes and short boots. It has navy and gray plate.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n112_c01.ja: 短身の鎧姿。高い角兜と黄色い目のある暗い顔、短い長靴がある。紺と灰色の板金鎧。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n112_c02.en: A short armored figure has a tall horned helmet, dark face with yellow eyes and short boots. It uses red, black and gold.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n112_c02.ja: 短身の鎧姿。高い角兜と黄色い目のある暗い顔、短い長靴がある。赤、黒、金色。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n114_c00.en: A compact bearded figure wears a round broad hat, contrasting coat and short boots. It has a violet hat and clothes and pale blue cuffs.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n114_c00.ja: 小柄でひげのある人物。丸い幅広帽と対照色の外套、短い長靴を着ける。紫の帽子と服に淡青の袖口。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n114_c01.en: A compact bearded figure wears a round broad hat, contrasting coat and short boots. It has a dark blue cap and violet outer layers.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n114_c01.ja: 小柄でひげのある人物。丸い幅広帽と対照色の外套、短い長靴を着ける。濃青の帽子に紫の外衣。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n114_c02.en: A compact bearded figure wears a round broad hat, contrasting coat and short boots. It has a red cap, green and red clothes and a yellow-brown beard.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n114_c02.ja: 小柄でひげのある人物。丸い幅広帽と対照色の外套、短い長靴を着ける。赤い帽子と緑と赤の服、黄褐色のひげ。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n116_c00.en: A stocky bird has a swept pointed crest, rounded eyes, a hooked yellow-orange beak, little claws and a short tail. It has white feathers.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n116_c00.ja: ずんぐりした鳥。後ろへ流れる尖り冠羽、丸い目、鉤形の黄橙のくちばし、小さな爪と短い尾がある。羽毛は白。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n116_c01.en: A stocky bird has a swept pointed crest, rounded eyes, a hooked yellow-orange beak, little claws and a short tail. It has dark blue-violet feathers.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n116_c01.ja: ずんぐりした鳥。後ろへ流れる尖り冠羽、丸い目、鉤形の黄橙のくちばし、小さな爪と短い尾がある。羽毛は濃い青紫。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n116_c02.en: A stocky bird has a swept pointed crest, rounded eyes, a hooked yellow-orange beak, little claws and a short tail. It has spread blue-violet wings.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n116_c02.ja: ずんぐりした鳥。後ろへ流れる尖り冠羽、丸い目、鉤形の黄橙のくちばし、小さな爪と短い尾がある。青紫の翼を広げる。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n116_c03.en: A stocky bird has a swept pointed crest, rounded eyes, a hooked yellow-orange beak, little claws and a short tail. It has yellow plumage.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n116_c03.ja: ずんぐりした鳥。後ろへ流れる尖り冠羽、丸い目、鉤形の黄橙のくちばし、小さな爪と短い尾がある。羽毛は黄色。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n116_c04.en: A stocky bird has a swept pointed crest, rounded eyes, a hooked yellow-orange beak, little claws and a short tail. It has red plumage.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n116_c04.ja: ずんぐりした鳥。後ろへ流れる尖り冠羽、丸い目、鉤形の黄橙のくちばし、小さな爪と短い尾がある。羽毛は赤。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n117_c00.en: A narrow face under a deep white hood has a pale robe flaring below the waist. It has a plum band over the brow and lavender trim.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n117_c00.ja: 深い白頭巾の下に細い顔がある。淡色のローブが腰から下で広がる。額の上にすもも色の帯があり、淡紫の縁がある。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n117_c01.en: A narrow face under a deep white hood has a pale robe flaring below the waist. It has brown hair and red trim at the sleeve and hem.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n117_c01.ja: 深い白頭巾の下に細い顔がある。淡色のローブが腰から下で広がる。茶髪で袖と裾が赤く縁取られる。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n118_c00.en: A large pointed hat hides almost all of a black face except two pale eyes. It wears an orange-brown hat and bright violet robe.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n118_c00.ja: 大きな尖り帽子が黒い顔のほとんどを隠し、淡い色の目二つがのぞく。橙褐色の帽子に鮮紫のローブ。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n118_c01.en: A large pointed hat hides almost all of a black face except two pale eyes. It wears a mustard hat and blue robe.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n118_c01.ja: 大きな尖り帽子が黒い顔のほとんどを隠し、淡い色の目二つがのぞく。からし色の帽子に青いローブ。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n120_c00.en: A tiny squat frog has raised yellow or pale eyes, a low pointed head and bent feet. It is bright green.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n120_c00.ja: ずんぐりした小さなカエル。黄色か淡色の出た目と低く尖った頭、曲げた足がある。鮮緑色。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n120_c01.en: A tiny squat frog has raised yellow or pale eyes, a low pointed head and bent feet. It is vivid blue-violet.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n120_c01.ja: ずんぐりした小さなカエル。黄色か淡色の出た目と低く尖った頭、曲げた足がある。鮮やかな青紫。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n120_c02.en: A tiny squat frog has raised yellow or pale eyes, a low pointed head and bent feet. It is muted pink-purple.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n120_c02.ja: ずんぐりした小さなカエル。黄色か淡色の出た目と低く尖った頭、曲げた足がある。くすんだ桃紫色。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n120_c03.en: A tiny squat frog has raised yellow or pale eyes, a low pointed head and bent feet. It is deep teal.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n120_c03.ja: ずんぐりした小さなカエル。黄色か淡色の出た目と低く尖った頭、曲げた足がある。濃い青緑。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n120_c04.en: A tiny squat frog has raised yellow or pale eyes, a low pointed head and bent feet. It is pale olive and white.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n120_c04.ja: ずんぐりした小さなカエル。黄色か淡色の出た目と低く尖った頭、曲げた足がある。淡いオリーブ色と白。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n122_c00.en: A minuscule figure has a simple round face, blocky sweater and tiny brown feet. It has blond hair and green clothing.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n122_c00.ja: ごく小さな人物。簡素な丸い顔、角張った上着、小さな茶色の足がある。金髪に緑の服。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n122_c01.en: A minuscule figure has a simple round face, blocky sweater and tiny brown feet. It has lavender hair and blue clothing.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n122_c01.ja: ごく小さな人物。簡素な丸い顔、角張った上着、小さな茶色の足がある。淡紫の髪に青い服。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n122_c02.en: A minuscule figure has a simple round face, blocky sweater and tiny brown feet. It has brown hair and a red shirt.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n122_c02.ja: ごく小さな人物。簡素な丸い顔、角張った上着、小さな茶色の足がある。茶髪に赤い上着。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n122_c03.en: A minuscule figure has a simple round face, blocky sweater and tiny brown feet. It has mint-green hair and a violet shirt.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n122_c03.ja: ごく小さな人物。簡素な丸い顔、角張った上着、小さな茶色の足がある。ミントグリーンの髪に紫の上着。

Field appearance mo_ff4_p001_c00.en: A compact fighter wears dark indigo plate with layered spiked shoulders, pale wrist openings and a long pointed helmet. Gold marks show at the eye and below the boots.
Field appearance mo_ff4_p001_c00.ja: 小柄な戦士が藍色の暗い板金鎧を着ける。肩に棘のある板が重なり、手首の開口部が淡く、兜は長く尖る。目元と長靴の下に金の模様。

Field appearance mo_ff4_p002_c00.en: A bright cyan dragon helm has a long pointed snout, swept gold side markings and a tiny red eye. Blue pointed shoulder plates, violet boots and a short tailing sash cover the rest.
Field appearance mo_ff4_p002_c00.ja: 鮮やかな水色の竜の兜に長く尖った鼻、横へ流れる金の模様と小さな赤い目がある。尖った青い肩甲、紫の長靴と短く流れる帯が残りを覆う。

Field appearance mo_ff4_p002_c01.en: The long dragon helm, spiked shoulders and narrow waist use rich violet and pink-violet shades, with gold and red accents. The ready battle stance crouches behind large layered plates.
Field appearance mo_ff4_p002_c01.ja: 長い竜の兜、尖った肩、細い腰は濃紫と桃紫で、金と赤の差し色がある。戦闘で構えると、重なった大きな装甲板の後ろにうずくまる。

Field appearance mo_ff4_p003_c00.en: A fair-haired woman with a pale face and green eyes wears green upper clothing and a long white cloak or skirt with pink trim. A high ponytail and longer white cape trail in the battle pose.
Field appearance mo_ff4_p003_c00.ja: 淡い顔と緑の目の金髪の女性。緑の上着に、桃色で縁取った長い白の外套かスカートを着ける。戦闘では高いポニーテールと長めの白いマントが後ろに流れる。

Field appearance mo_ff4_p004_c00.en: A short pale figure has sweeping green hair, a pink hair accent and bright blue and pink clothing. A yellow cape trails behind the field and battle forms, with a gold shoulder detail clearly outlined in battle.
Field appearance mo_ff4_p004_c00.ja: 背の低い色白の人物。流した緑の髪に桃色の髪飾りがあり、鮮やかな青と桃色の服。黄色いマントが野外でも戦闘でも後ろへ流れ、戦闘では肩の金飾りがはっきりする。

Field appearance mo_ff4_p005_c00.en: A broad bearded man has a large blue and orange helmet with a pale horizontal goggle band. The field outfit includes brown beard and shoes, red-orange sleeves and blue fabric.
Field appearance mo_ff4_p005_c00.ja: 肩幅の広いひげの男。大きな青と橙の兜に淡い横長のゴーグルが付く。野外では茶色のひげと靴、赤橙の袖、青い布が見える。

Field appearance mo_ff4_p006_c00.en: A small elder has flyaway white hair, a long white beard and blue circular spectacles. He wears a bright purple and pink cloak edged with gold. The large cape swings outward in the battle Ready frame.
Field appearance mo_ff4_p006_c00.ja: 小柄な老人物。逆立つ白髪と長い白ひげ、青い丸眼鏡がある。金で縁取った鮮やかな紫と桃の外套を着け、戦闘で構えると大きなマントが外へ翻る。

Field appearance mo_ff4_p007_c00.en: A slim fair-haired man wears a red cap with white trim, green scarf and long green cape, red tunic and short brown boots. His light sleeves and longer blond hair are clearer in the side battle frame.
Field appearance mo_ff4_p007_c00.ja: 金髪で細身の男。白い縁の赤い帽子、緑のスカーフと長い緑マント、赤い上着、短い茶の長靴を着ける。戦闘で横を向くと淡い袖と長い金髪がよく見える。

Field appearance mo_ff4_p008_c00.en: A muscular bare-chested fighter has a shaved front scalp, short dark facial hair, a braided tail of hair, blue wraps and red trousers with yellow trim.
Field appearance mo_ff4_p008_c00.ja: 筋肉質で上半身裸の格闘家。頭の前側を剃り、短い黒いひげと編んだ長い髪がある。青い巻き布と黄色く縁取った赤いズボンを着ける。

Field appearance mo_ff4_p009_c00.en: A young pale figure with a brown bob wears a short white and green outfit and a bright red cape. Small boots and a short trailing gold tie appear beside the cape in battle.
Field appearance mo_ff4_p009_c00.ja: 色白で茶色のボブの若い人物。短い白と緑の服に鮮赤のマントを羽織る。戦闘ではマントの横に小さな長靴と短く流れる金の紐が見える。

Field appearance mo_ff4_p010_c00.en: A young pale figure has swept brown hair, a small top tie and a bright green cape over a white-and-orange outfit.
Field appearance mo_ff4_p010_c00.ja: 若い色白の人物で、流した茶髪を頭頂で小さく結ぶ。白と橙の服の上に鮮緑のマントを羽織る。

Field appearance mo_ff4_p011_c00.en: A lean pale figure has spiky white hair, a lavender lower-face guard and a white-violet scarf, arm guards and coat. The side battle frame shows the layered blue and gold trim, dark knees and long scarf ends.
Field appearance mo_ff4_p011_c00.ja: 淡い顔の細身の人物。尖った白髪、淡紫の下顔当て、白紫のスカーフと腕当て、上着を身に着ける。戦闘の横姿では青と金の重なった縁、暗い膝と長いスカーフの端が見える。

Field appearance mo_ff4_p012_c00.en: A bald elder has a huge light blue-white beard and trailing white hair. A purple robe and cape drape to the floor.
Field appearance mo_ff4_p012_c00.ja: 禿頭の老人物。青白い大きなひげと後ろへ流れる白髪があり、紫のローブとマントが床まで垂れる。

Field appearance mo_ff4_p013_c00.en: A fair figure wears ivory and gold armor, a lavender swept hairstyle or headpiece and a red brow jewel.
Field appearance mo_ff4_p013_c00.ja: 色白の人物。象牙色と金の鎧に、流した淡紫の髪か頭飾りと赤い額の宝石がある。

Field appearance mo_ff4_p014_c00.en: A slim pale figure wears a fitted bright green outfit with trailing sleeves or fabric. Long vivid green hair has a little pink ornament.
Field appearance mo_ff4_p014_c00.ja: 色白で細身の人物。体に沿う鮮緑の衣装の袖か布が垂れ、長い鮮緑の髪に小さな桃色の飾りがある。

Field appearance mo_ff4_v001_c00.en: A small wooden boat has a gold-rimmed hull, dark crossbars and a bright white side sail.
Field appearance mo_ff4_v001_c00.ja: 小さな木造船。金縁の船体、暗い横桟、鮮やかな白い横帆がある。

Field appearance mo_ff4_v002_c00.en: A small orange craft stands over two dark wheels or side housings, with dark circular front and rear details.
Field appearance mo_ff4_v002_c00.ja: 橙色の小さな乗り物が、暗い車輪か外箱二つの上にある。前と後ろに暗い丸い部分が付く。

Field appearance mo_ff4_v003_c00.en: A narrow ship has a pointed red-orange lower hull, pale upper frame and short high propeller. It uses a purple and bright orange deck.
Field appearance mo_ff4_v003_c00.ja: 細身の飛行艇。下に尖った赤橙の船体、上に淡い枠組みと、短い高い位置のプロペラがある。甲板は紫と鮮橙色。

Field appearance mo_ff4_v003_c01.en: A narrow ship has a pointed red-orange lower hull, pale upper frame and short high propeller. It has yellow rotor blades and a more pronounced red deck.
Field appearance mo_ff4_v003_c01.ja: 細身の飛行艇。下に尖った赤橙の船体、上に淡い枠組みと、短い高い位置のプロペラがある。回転翼が黄色で、甲板の赤がより目立つ。

Field appearance mo_ff4_v004_c00.en: A red and charcoal airship has gold fittings and a pale propeller and rail edges.
Field appearance mo_ff4_v004_c00.ja: 赤と黒灰色の飛空艇。金の金具と淡いプロペラ、淡い手すりの縁がある。

Field appearance mo_ff4_v005_c00.en: A squat bright orange craft has a large dark gray windshield, gold and yellow lights, and thick squared trim at its sides.
Field appearance mo_ff4_v005_c00.ja: ずんぐりした鮮橙色の乗り物。大きな濃灰色の風防に金と黄色の灯りがあり、脇は角張った厚い縁。

Field appearance mo_ff4_v006_c00.en: A broad dark silver craft has layered rounded ridges, side fins and red and yellow strips around its ends.
Field appearance mo_ff4_v006_c00.ja: 幅広く暗い銀色の乗り物。丸い隆起が重なり、横にひれがあり、両端を赤と黄の帯が囲む。

Field appearance mo_ff4_v007_c00.en: A tiny red airship sprite has a pale metal frame, small pale tail pieces and a gold propeller.
Field appearance mo_ff4_v007_c00.ja: 小さな赤い飛空艇。淡い金属の枠組みと小さな淡色の尾部、金のプロペラが付く。

Weapon appearance wp_ff1_ma00_c00.en: A squarish orange-gold patch of folded cloth flashes brighter along the upper edge.
Weapon appearance wp_ff1_ma00_c00.ja: 折り重なった金橙色の四角い布が、上の縁から明るく光る。

Weapon appearance wp_ff1_sh00_c00.en: A rounded orange-gold shield has a broad gray metal rim.
Weapon appearance wp_ff1_sh00_c00.ja: 金橙色の丸い盾を、幅広い灰色の金属が縁取る。

Weapon appearance wp_ff4_ar00_c00.en: A common narrow arrow has a straight brown shaft, a little orange-gold point, a silver band and a split pale tail.
Weapon appearance wp_ff4_ar00_c00.ja: 細く真っすぐな矢。尾には淡色の矢羽が二枚ある。茶の矢柄に小さな橙金の矢じりと銀の帯。
